bluejetty:00132770:ios.summary: Unblur, sharpen & upscale blurry, grainy or old photos and videos to crystal-clear HD and 4K quality— the fastest way to fix a blur photo in seconds. YouCam Enhance is your all-in-one AI photo and video editor & enhancer — instantly restore
bluejetty:00132770:ios.description:
Unblur, sharpen & upscale blurry, grainy or old photos and videos to crystal-clear HD and 4K quality— the fastest way to fix a blur photo in seconds. YouCam Enhance is your all-in-one AI photo and video editor & enhancer — instantly restore, denoise, and upscale pixelated visuals, then create stunning AI images and videos from text prompts.
AI Photo Restoration
- AI Enhance with Scenario Mode: Upload a batch of photos — portraits, landscapes, documents, or anime — and let AI auto-select the best mode to enhance, color-correct, and upscale each image.
- AI Photo Repair: Erase deep scratches and damage, and restore blurry old photos with rich, true detail. Use Essential for quick fixes, or Advanced to reconstruct true-to-life facial details.
- AI Colorize: Watch history come alive in color. Add vibrant, natural colors to black-and-white photos. Use Essential for an instant touch, or Advanced for richer, high-fidelity tones.
AI Lighting: Automatically detects and corrects dark or overexposed shots for flawless exposure and clarity.
AI Photo & Face Editing Tools
- Effects & Custom Filters: Explore curated trendy filters or extract color tones from your favorite photos to create and save custom presets for your feed.
- Auto Object Remover: Instantly remove unwanted people, wires, or distractions from photos with smart auto-detect.
- Background Eraser & Changer: Instantly remove or change your photo background with AI — generate new backdrops from a simple prompt.
- Image Extender: Effortlessly expand image and resize photos for any social post — perfect for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Pexels without losing quality.
- AI Facelift in Face Retouch & Reshape: Transform your look with advanced photo retouching and sculpting tools, smoothing and lifting facial features for stunning, natural results.
AI Agent: Chat-based Photo & Video Assistant
- Smart Enhance & Edit: Upscale quality, fix lighting, or modify any detail through text.
- Text to Image & Video: Generate stunning visuals and cinematic footage from scratch.
- Image to Image: Reimagine photos in new styles — sketches, cartoons, and more.
AI Image Generator
- AI Text to Image: Turn text prompts into eye-catching visuals across a range of styles and effects.
- AI Image to Image: Reimagine existing photos with trending styles instantly.
- Multi-AI Models: Powered by GPT Image 2.5, YouCam Image 2.0, Nano Banana 2, Seedream 5.0 Lite, and Flux.2 Pro.
AI Video Enhancer
- AI Video Expansion: Extend any video beyond its original frame — turn a vertical clip into widescreen, a landscape into a Reel, or a square post for your feed, while dragging and resizing to fit your shot.
- AI Video Enhance: Sharpen and upscale video to stunning 4K video quality.
- AI Video Repair: Correct damaged or corrupted video frames with AI precision.
- AI Video Lighting: Automatically balance exposure to fix dark video clips or correct overexposed footage.
- AI Video Face Swap: Seamlessly swap faces in videos with realistic, high-fidelity results.
- AI Video Denoise: Eliminate grain for crystal-clear visuals, even in low-light footage.
AI Video Generator
- Image to Video: Animate static images into dynamic video sequences with realistic motion.
- Text to Video: Convert written prompts into cinematic video clips instantly.
- Multi-AI Models: Powered by Wan 2.7, Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 Omni, Sora 2, YouCam Motion, Google Veo 3.1, Vide Q2 Pro, PixVerse C1, and Hailuo 02.
MADE FOR
Anyone fixing blurry, low-res, or old photos and videos, creators needing a fast AI editing app, and artists exploring AI image and video generation.
Download YouCam Enhance now to unblur photos and videos in a wink, restore old memories, and create AI visuals like never before!

Welcome to the enchanting world of Nail Salon, a creative and fun nail art game designed especially for kids! Let your child's imagination run wild as they become the ultimate nail artist. With Nail Salon, little fashionistas can express their creativity and design the most dazzling and unique nails.

A Colorful Nail Palette: Choose from a wide range of vibrant nail polish colors to paint and decorate nails.
Nail Art Studio: Add mesmerizing nail art designs, patterns, and images to make each nail a masterpiece.
Stickers and Gems: Embellish nails with cute stickers, glittering gems, and charming accessories for that extra glam.
Nail Shapes: Experiment with different nail shapes and lengths to create unique nail styles.
Nail Parties: Host virtual nail parties with friends and family, and showcase your nail art skills.
Photo Booth: Capture and share your nail creations with friends and family.

Endless Creativity: No rules, no limits—just endless fun and creativity!
Nail Salon is the perfect game for children to express their artistic side and create beautiful nail designs. It's a delightful way to encourage imagination, color exploration, and fine motor skills in a safe and entertaining environment. Download Nail Salon now and let your child's inner nail artist shine!
Get ready to paint, decorate, and have a blast in the wonderful world of nails. Start your nail art adventure today!

SEC³URE Companion Mobile App
By IntelliCentrics
This companion mobile app makes it even easier for you to access and support every hospital you visit. From the convenience of your mobile device: Check the status at each of your healthcare facilities, snap a picture and upload documents for verification, add new facilities as you visit, and accept facility policies “on the go.”
MONITOR YOUR STATUS
• Identify compliance status by facility
• View outstanding policies by facility
• View outstanding credentials by facility
• Check REPScore
• Know before you go
EASILY PERFORM KEY TASKS
• Use your camera phone to snap images and upload documents for verification by IntelliCentrics
• Edit your profile photo
• Receive proof document updates
• 
• Check into facilities remotely and receive an electronic badge on your mobile device (for participating facilities)
• Check out of facilities remotely (for participating facilities)
• Dispute negative REPScore events
FACILITY ACCESS
• Access nationwide database of hospitals
• Easily add and delete facilities you visit
• Read and accept facility policies before you visit
• View all of your facilities on a map
• Get directions via the Maps application
IMPORTANT NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPERS:
If you have any questions, feedback or suggestions, please contact us directly at (817) SEC3URE (732-3873) or CustomerService.US@IntelliCentrics.com.
About IntelliCentrics, Inc.
For more than ten years, at more than 10,000 unique locations of care across six countries, the SEC3URE technology platform has been making it easier for vendors and their representatives to meet hospital regulations—all on a single instance of software. IntelliCentrics’ CVO is fully Certified by NCQA for 11 out of 11 verification services.

Period Tracker, the easiest way to track your health! 
*Now supports HealthKit, 3DTouch, TouchID, portrait charts, data share with your partner, Advanced TTC Mode (the easiest way to get pregnant by following the homepage timeline’s simple prompted instructions!), and Pregnancy Mode with articles and week-by-week images.
Period Tracker is SIMPLE and CUTE. 
* Press a button at the start of your period every month. Period Tracker logs your dates and calculates the average of your past 3 months' menstrual cycles to predict the start date of your next period. 
* View your current and future period dates, ovulation and fertile days, moods, symptoms, weight, temp, and fertility notes in a simple month-view calendar. 
* Discreet iPhone icon simply reads "PTracker." 
Period Tracker is FILLED WITH FEATURES. 
* Take daily notes of menstrual symptoms including Spotting, Flow, Cramps, Headaches, Backaches, Bloating, Tender Breasts, and Body Aches! 
* Track your weight, temperature and moods (over 30+ moods to choose from!) 
* Add custom symptoms and moods 
* Month-view calendar features intimacy, symptoms and moods icons mapped right onto the calendar.
* Charts! Beautiful, comprehensive and handy. Charts show weight, temp, symptoms, period length, cycle length, and more.
* Monthly automatic online Backup/Restore feature or you can backup manually.
* Homescreen shows your predicted ovulation, eight day "fertile window,” and your cycle day. Great for trying to conceive.
* Pregnancy mode activates countdown to baby's due date and week-by-week articles.
* Protect your privacy with TOUCH ID or with a passcode option that is fast and easy.

* Notes list view where you can view, edit, change date, delete and email individual notes 
* Export your period dates and notes to email for doctor's visits. 
* 12 beautiful skins for free

bluejetty:00014879:ios.description:
Start Selling Online for Free with Vepaar Store!
Join our community of over 100,000 entrepreneurs and begin your journey into e-commerce today. Vepaar Store is designed to help you start selling online without any upfront costs. Whether you want to sell physical products, digital goods, or services, Vepaar provides the easiest way to set up your online store.
Insightful Dashboard & Orders
Get started with our intuitive dashboard, which offers essential statistics to help you manage your sales effectively. Track your performance and make informed decisions to enhance your business strategy.
Everything You Need to Sell Online
Under the ‘Store’ section, you’ll find countless features that streamline your business management:
Product Creation: Easily create various product types—simple, variable, and digital. Whether it’s a single item or a complex offering, we’ve got you covered.
Categories: Organize your products by designing a comprehensive catalog with unlimited categories. Make it easy for customers to find what they’re looking for.
Custom Badges: Highlight specific products with customizable badges that make them stand out in your store.
Charges Setup: Implement taxes, bulk order fees, gift wrapping, and other charges tailored to your business needs.
Inventory Management: Keep a close eye on your stock levels and make adjustments to product quantities with ease.
Shipping Options: Set delivery prices based on cart value, areas you serve, or product weight to provide a seamless customer experience.
Sell Digital Products
Your online store isn’t limited to just physical commodities. Vepaar allows you to tap into the growing market for digital products, including e-books, software, audio, media, and more.
Customize Your Checkout Process
With Vepaar, you can fully customize your checkout form to match your requirements. Enable or disable fields as needed to enhance the customer experience and streamline the purchasing process.
Product Variants and Attributes
Create multiple product variants with customizable options for stock, pricing, images, and more. Define unique attributes for each product to help customers make informed decisions.
Checkout Add-Ons
Offer additional services at checkout, such as gift wrapping or personalized messages, to elevate the shopping experience for your customers.
Quick User Authentication via WhatsApp
For faster checkouts, Vepaar allows customers to place orders through WhatsApp. A brief authentication process ensures secure transactions, making the buying experience quicker and more convenient.
Coupon Management
Easily create and manage coupon codes for your customers. You can define minimum and maximum discount amounts, set usage limits, and choose whether to display the coupons on your store.
Seamless Payment Integrations
Vepaar Store features smooth payment integrations that facilitate easy and secure transactions. Say goodbye to complicated payment processes and enjoy a more straightforward checkout experience for your customers.
Privacy Policy: https://vepaar.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://vepaar.com/terms/

bluejetty:00060712:ios.description:
Fill your day with stories. All You Can Books free app gives you UNLIMITED, instant access to wonderful Audiobooks, eBooks, Best Seller Summaries, and Foreign Language courses plus tens of thousands of Podcasts. Enjoy them anytime, anywhere.

• Built for trucking — drivers, owner-operators, fleets, and recruiters in one place.
• Smart matching that surfaces the right jobs and the right drivers first.
• A community on the road: video, Meet, and messaging.
Whether you're chasing your next load, your next job, or your next driver, FreightPro keeps you moving.
Questions or feedback? Reach us at support@freightpro.ai.

bluejetty:00079847:ios.description:
Fantasy Color: Unleash Your Creativity with This Dream Coloring Game!
Do you love coloring and letting your creativity flow? Dive into Fantasy Color, the ultimate fantasy-inspired coloring game! Designed for everyone, from coloring beginners to art aficionados, Fantasy Color offers a vibrant and relaxing experience that lets you escape reality, immerse in stunning artwork, and bring breathtaking scenes to life. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or find new inspiration, Fantasy Color is your perfect companion. Create your own masterpieces, experiment with color palettes, and share your artistic creations with friends and family!
Why Choose Fantasy Color?
Relaxing & Therapeutic: Coloring has been proven to reduce stress and improve focus. With Fantasy Color, you can unwind and enjoy each stroke as you watch illustrations come to life.
Huge Art Collection: Discover hundreds of beautifully crafted illustrations, from mystical landscapes and magical creatures to intricate mandalas and charming fantasy characters. There’s always a new picture to color, keeping the experience fresh and exciting.
Daily New Artworks: We release fresh, hand-drawn illustrations every day to keep you inspired! Explore new content regularly and make coloring part of your daily routine.
Unique Color Palettes & Themes: Choose from a variety of color palettes, designed to enhance each artwork’s unique charm. You’ll find palettes inspired by nature, fantasy, and other captivating themes, allowing for endless creative combinations.
Save & Share: Proud of your masterpiece? Share your art directly with friends on social media or save it to your device to set as wallpaper or background. Show off your creativity to the world!
Vibrant Fantasy Worlds: Explore various themed categories, from magical forests and enchanted castles to otherworldly creatures and intricate mandalas.
Join a Thriving Community of Artists!
Coloring is always more fun with others. Join our online community to see other players' masterpieces, participate in coloring events, and get inspired by the collective creativity of Fantasy Color users around the world.
Why Coloring Is So Popular
Coloring helps reduce stress, stimulates creativity, and fosters mindfulness. It’s a perfect way to take a break from everyday life, focus your mind, and create something beautiful. Fantasy Color takes this experience to the next level with high-quality fantasy themes, letting you lose yourself in the joy of art without any limitations.
Regular Updates & Improvements
We’re committed to providing the best coloring experience, constantly updating Fantasy Color with new illustrations, features, and improvements based on user feedback. Our team is dedicated to making your coloring experience better every day!
Join the Fantasy Color Adventure Today!
Discover the magic of coloring with Fantasy Color, where creativity meets relaxation. Whether you're at home, commuting, or simply want a break, Fantasy Color is here to offer you a world of wonder and calm. Download now and start your coloring journey today!
Download Fantasy Color and immerse yourself in a world of colors and fantasy. Don’t forget to rate and review to help us keep improving!
Subscription pricing and terms：
In Fantasy Color we offer you the following three subscription options:
1. A weekly subscription costs $4.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per week.
2. A monthly subscription costs $9.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per month.
3. A yearly subscription costs $59.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per year.
After buying the subscriptions, you will remove the non-optional banner and interstitial adverts from the game. In addition, you'll get unlimited hints, and remove watermarks from all completed pictures.
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy please go to the following link:
Terms of Use:
https://home.xlearning.group/terms_of_services.html
Privacy Policy:
https://home.xlearning.group/privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00100478:ios.description:
Star Twinkle: Pop & Dream is an engaging Connect-the-Pairs puzzle game that challenges your pattern recognition and strategic thinking. Match identical star pairs by connecting them through straight lines, L-shaped turns, or Z-shaped paths that may extend beyond the visible grid.
The game features 30 progressively challenging levels across three difficulty groups: Novice, Advanced, and Expert. Each level offers unique grid sizes, star varieties, and time limits, providing hours of brain-teasing entertainment.
With beautiful star graphics, smooth animations, and an intuitive touch interface, Star Twinkle: Pop & Dream delivers a delightful gaming experience for puzzle lovers of all ages. Clear all the stars before time runs out!

User-Friendly Interface:
The Passport Photo Creator app is designed for users of all levels of tech-savviness. Its intuitive interface guides you through each step, making the entire process quick and stress-free.

bluejetty:00174885:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00174885:ios.description:
Shift Worker is designed for people who need a quick and easy way to enter and view their shifts.
A traditional calendar is not always ideal for shift workers. Sometimes it's not easy to see your upcoming shift schedule very clearly, especially if your shifts don't fall into the traditional working week. Shift Worker solves this problem and turns the frustrating task of entry into a quick and easy experience.
Shift Worker allows you to create your own types of shifts by combining visually-attractive icons with letters/numbers so that they can be easily identified at a glance. By including a range of icons (such as suns and stars for day and night shifts) in a variety of colors, any combination is possible for all types of shifts.
Entering shifts can be done quickly by simply selecting a type of shift and tapping on each date it occurs. An entire month of shifts could be entered in seconds, an entire year in a few minutes!
In addition, Shift Worker allows you create multiple calendars to see friends and family shifts! You can send your shifts to others so they can also see your shifts at a glance as an image or in their copy of Shift Worker. To make things even simpler, you can even save your shifts to your iPhone/iPod's background so that referring to your upcoming shift schedule is as simple as picking up your iPhone/iPod. 
Shift Worker also includes the ability to create colored personalized notes for each date. Notes can be used anytime additional information needs to be added to a date.
FEATURES:
- Create a virtually unlimited amount of shift types
- Enter shifts on the calendar months in advance in seconds
- Add your rotation and automatically fill the calendar in a few simple steps
- Show friends and family shifts using multiple calendars
- View the calendar in timeline format to see your shift flow at a glance
- Create colored personalized notes for any date on the calendar
- Include week of year or week 1/2 alternating pattern on calendar
- Jump to any month by using the "Goto" button
- Save a month's worth of shifts to your background
- Share your shifts to others via email, messages and social media.
- Import other Shift Worker shifts and view them all within the one app
- No ads!
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00186288:ios.description:
Start your child’s musical journey today with Prodigies, a colorful and accessible music curriculum for kids, parents & teachers.
Join Mr. Rob and a colorful cast of characters as kids sing, hand-sign and play through hundreds of family friendly melodies, songs and classical pieces.
When you enroll, you’ll immediately unlock …
• Our Award Winning General Music Curriculum for Kids Ages 1-14
 • Piano Prodigies for kids ages 3+
 • Ukulele Prodigies for kids 7+
 • Recorder curriculum for kids 7+
• Holiday, cultural & religious songs for multiple faiths & cultures 
Prodigies gives kids a fun way to access pitch development activities, games, songs & lessons during their formative childhood years. This allows young kids (before age 8) to develop the amazing skill of perfect pitch!
Older children can start at the beginning to build up their musical ear, or jump in on Level 2 material where we’re focused on more difficult songs, concepts, theory and instruments. Older students will rapidly develop their sense for relative pitch and may still develop some of skills associated with perfect pitch!
For parents, Prodigies delivers music lessons on-demand so you can keep your kids learning at home while knowing they’re interacting with something safe, ad-free and designed to teach them music.
Your home will come to life with music as your kids learn to sing with Solfeggi, play their first instrument and come to understand the language of music. It works as an after school activity, we have detailed lessons for more involved homeschooling, and even babies and toddlers will learn a lot about the musical language while enjoying this educational alternative to TV!
Plus, Prodigies is available across multiple platforms to make sure you can always pull up your child’s favorite music lessons wherever you go!
For teachers, both in the classroom and in the music studio, Prodigies will totally transform engagement. Plus, we’ve built a ton of videos, activities and lessons for teachers who want to take things further, and you’ll immediately recognized our use of the Chromanotes™ color coding system (a la Boomwhackers™) and you’ll secretly enjoy all of the Kodaly & Orff methodologies turned into silly cartoons for your kiddos.
For ensemble leaders, our Performance Tracks will help you put on wow-worthy rehearsals and concerts, even in your first year as an elementary music teacher. We also have more advanced LMS features available on the web for group leaders!
Download the free app, check out our free starter material, and when you’re ready, enroll to unlock all 500 videos. Only one membership is needed per household, so you and the whole family can start #HappyMusicing today!
-Already have an account? Sign-In to access your subscription.

Start your child’s musical journey today with Prodigies, a colorful and accessible music curriculum for kids, parents & teachers.

Join Mr. Rob and a colorful cast of characters as kids sing, hand-sign and play through hundreds of family friendly melodies, songs and classical pieces.

When you enroll, you’ll immediately unlock …
• Our Award Winning General Music Curriculum for Kids Ages 1-14
 • Piano Prodigies for kids ages 3+
 • Ukulele Prodigies for kids 7+
 • Recorder curriculum for kids 7+
• Holiday, cultural & religious songs for multiple faiths & cultures 

Prodigies gives kids a fun way to access pitch development activities, games, songs & lessons during their formative childhood years. This allows young kids (before age 8) to develop the amazing skill of perfect pitch!

Older children can start at the beginning to build up their musical ear, or jump in on Level 2 material where we’re focused on more difficult songs, concepts, theory and instruments. Older students will rapidly develop their sense for relative pitch and may still develop some of skills associated with perfect pitch!

For parents, Prodigies delivers music lessons on-demand so you can keep your kids learning at home while knowing they’re interacting with something safe, ad-free and designed to teach them music.

Your home will come to life with music as your kids learn to sing with Solfeggi, play their first instrument and come to understand the language of music. It works as an after school activity, we have detailed lessons for more involved homeschooling, and even babies and toddlers will learn a lot about the musical language while enjoying this educational alternative to TV!

Plus, Prodigies is available across multiple platforms to make sure you can always pull up your child’s favorite music lessons wherever you go!

For teachers, both in the classroom and in the music studio, Prodigies will totally transform engagement. Plus, we’ve built a ton of videos, activities and lessons for teachers who want to take things further, and you’ll immediately recognized our use of the Chromanotes™ color coding system (a la Boomwhackers™) and you’ll secretly enjoy all of the Kodaly & Orff methodologies turned into silly cartoons for your kiddos.

For ensemble leaders, our Performance Tracks will help you put on wow-worthy rehearsals and concerts, even in your first year as an elementary music teacher. We also have more advanced LMS features available on the web for group leaders!

Download the free app, check out our free starter material, and when you’re ready, enroll to unlock all 500 videos. Only one membership is needed per household, so you and the whole family can start #HappyMusicing today!

bluejetty:00061220:ios.description:
"隨手讀中文聖經"讓你隨時隨地研讀聖經,它不僅提供了簡單而快速的方法來閱讀聖經(特別是對聖經還不熟的讀者,能輕易及最快速地翻閱任何新舊約的任一書章節),也提供了許多方便而有用的功能,成為你研讀聖經的好幫手。 
* 支援繁,簡中文使用者介面; Universal app(可同時安裝在iPhone以及iPad); 直向以及橫向顯示;所有資料庫已附上,不需要internet連接. 
* 支援利用iOS本身的語音功能來朗讀所有的中英文聖經譯本,不需下載龐大的人聲錄音資料庫(需另外選購,中文語音包括:國語,普通話,廣東話及英語,可用作學習語言工具).
* 市面上最快速的聖經查詢軟件之一(比較幾款最暢銷的中英文聖經iPhone軟件),是少數手機聖經軟體中,使用效率,功能強大的SQL數據庫引擎.瞬間即可查閱或搜尋到任何經節. 
* 新增/編輯個人筆記;若該節經文有個人筆記,個人筆記圖標會顯示在該節經文旁邊,方便進入閱讀或編輯.另外這種個人筆記Window是浮動的,半透明和可移動的,這樣可以同時閱讀聖經經文和個人筆記. 
* 超強的筆記編輯功能: 目前市面上唯一支援“豐富文字編輯功能”. “豐富文字編輯功能” ，包括“粗體” ， “斜體” ， “劃底線” ， “刪除線” ， “字體顏色/加亮/大小” ， “有序或無序列表”等，
* 除了和合本, 呂振中,中文英皇欽定本,簡明聖經外,也包含英文的ASV, BBE, DARBY, ISV, KJV, NHEB, WEB, YLT聖經文本.不像其他軟件需另外設定或多幾道步驟,可透過Navigation Bar上的切換聖經圖標,輕輕一按即可輕鬆地切換到不同的聖經文本. 
* 利用滾輪方便地選擇所要查閱的書卷以及章節.並可鍵入該書卷的中文或英文簡寫的第一或二字,即可跳選該書卷. 
* 強大而豐富的搜索功能:搜索經文或你的個人筆記中的任何字串.可設定舊約,新約,整本聖經,或限定那些經卷,也可以使用“AND“或“OR”來縮小搜索範圍。效率,功能強大的SQL數據庫查詢,能在幾秒鐘內搜尋到你要找的經文. 
* 搜索結果將顯示所有包含該字串的經文以及該字串出現在各書卷的頻率.目前市面上大部分的聖經軟件,只能一頁一頁的查詢,無法一次及一目瞭然地顯示所有的查詢結果. 
* 提供方便的聖經章節書卷跳選功能,利用右下方的游標功能鍵,可輕易的跳選上或下一章節書卷. 
* 每節經文以及個人筆記可以複製或email出去 
* “即時搜索“設置,如果設定,當你輸入任何字串時,它同時的即時搜索經文. * 自動儲存任何搜索或查找過的經文歷史.也可以加入個人書籤.從"我的記錄"-個人筆記,書籤和歷史都可以立即跳到該節經文. 
* 豐富的個人設置,可以設置聖經文本,聖經文字顯示的字型/顏色/大小,背景圖片(可選擇內置或從相冊中添加自己的相片為背景) 
* 可另外選購授權研經資料: 中文-新譯本(香港環球聖經公會授權), 中文NET聖經, 英文-ESV, NASB, NET, Message, NKJV bible 
* 可另外選購"隨手讀中文聖經專業版"-功能包括Dictionary搜尋/Strong Number原文搜尋, 和合本/KJV with Strong Number, 所有不同經文文本對照比較, MHCC, CLARKE, JFB聖經注釋等.
* Latest info: http://facebook.com/handybible

Youper is an artificial intelligence application that uses conversational techniques to help you track your mood, reflect on your emotional well-being, and organize your thoughts in a beautiful journal.
Youper is designed with safety as a core principle, with safeguards implemented to help prevent harmful interactions. For details on Youper's safety protocols, visit www.youper.ai.
TERMS
Premium features are available via subscription, which automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends through your iTunes Account Settings. You can cancel your subscription anytime.
Terms and conditions: https://www.youper.ai/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://www.youper.ai/privacy-policy
IMPORTANT DISCLOSURES
Medical Disclaimer: Youper does not offer any diagnostic measurements or treatment advice. The app is not a substitute for professional mental health care. Always consult a licensed mental health professional if you are going through a crisis or need medical attention.
AI Disclosure: Youper is powered entirely by artificial intelligence. You are interacting with an AI system, not a human. All responses are generated by AI and have not been reviewed by a licensed mental health professional.
Age Restriction: Youper is intended for users aged 18 and older. Users must confirm they are 18 years of age or older to create an account and use Youper. Youper is not designed or intended for use by minors. Companion chatbots, including Youper, may not be suitable for some minors. Parents and guardians should be aware that this application is not intended for individuals under 18 years of age.
CRISIS RESOURCES
Youper is not an emergency service and cannot provide crisis intervention. If you are experiencing a mental health emergency, suicidal thoughts, or thoughts of self-harm, please contact one of the following resources immediately:
988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline — Call or text 988 (available 24/7)
Crisis Text Line — Text HOME to 741741
Emergency Services — Call 911
For information about Youper's safety protocols, including our approach to crisis prevention and detection, visit: www.youper.ai

bluejetty:00063056:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00063056:ios.description:
Blast into summer with Bubble Mania, a puzzle-popping adventure of epic proportions! 
A puzzle adventure game with cute kitties, huge worlds and wicked baddies? You’ve gotta be kitten me! Defeat the Evil Bubble Wizard and rescue baby critters!
Throw bubbles and match colors to pop and drop your way to victory. 
"Bubble Mania is an extremely addictive game that any mobile user should have in their library of apps." -Gameteep.net
"The most polished bubble popper to date." -Gamezebo
=BUBBLE MANIA FEATURES=
700+ levels of Challenging Puzzles!
Inspired by the best arcade games and the smartest puzzle games, Bubble Mania presents a fun, challenging and addicting new way to have a blast with bubbles.
Adventure across a stunning world. Throw bubbles in sparkly swamps, amazing airships, and chocolate covered islands!
Travel across an amazing world filled with color and variety on a saga to rescue the trapped Babies! Shoot and pop bubbles to rescue the Babies trapped inside, and create combos to score even higher. As you blast more bubbles, you’ll unlock new areas filled with more challenges!
Score Big Bonuses - beat your friends’ scores!
Use Bubble-Boosts and combos to get bonuses and score big! Ricochet Bubbles using the trail of dots to land trick shots, and drop Bubbles to pop them instantly.
Power Up with Rainbow and Bomb Bubbles!
Puzzle games have you on edge? Don’t get angry – get powered up! Use Rainbow Bubbles to pop any color, Bomb Bubbles to blast through the level, or Super Score to double your points! Keep playing to discover even more fun power-ups! Can you master them all?
Master tricky obstacles like the explosive Lightning Bubble!
Watch out for bad Bubbles! The Lightning Bubble will give you a shock, while Frozen Bubbles will encase each Bubble in a shield of diamond. Use your wits to outsmart them all!
You’ll love the Exciting Animations and playful music!
The bubble saga comes to life with cute characters, incredible animations and amazing music!
FREE updates with new puzzles and powers!
Bubble Mania is totally free to play and download, and is constantly being updated! Check back often for free levels, powers and more!
2 control methods - pick the one that works best for you!
Choose from 2 control methods designed just for your iOS device! Enjoy unparalleled precision no matter how you choose to play.
Top notch performance on your iPhone, iPad, or iPod Touch.
Blast Bubbles in a colorful rescue saga as you travel the world. Shoot each Bubble to rescue a new Baby buddy, and master tons of power-ups to score big and defeat the Bubble Wizard in this classic arcade adventure!
Download Bubble Mania today, and prove yourself the ultimate Bubble shooter! 
Please note: Your device must have an active internet connection to download additional levels.
Please note that Bubble Mania™ is free to play, but you can purchase in-app items with real money. To delete this feature, on your device go to Settings Menu -> General -> Restrictions option. You can then simply turn off In-App Purchases under "Allowed Content". In addition, Bubble Mania™ may link to social media services, such as Facebook, and Storm8 will have access to your information through such services.

Fall asleep fast to 300 high-quality full-stereo recordings from around the world.
Sleep deeply every night, and wake up feeling fresh and energized.
Soothing Sleep Sounds provides a huge catalog of 300 high-quality, naturally recorded sounds. Much better than synthetic sounds and short repetitive loops, these are real-world sounds with all the richness, texture, and nuance of the natural environment.
And 125+ high-quality sounds can be downloaded for FREE, without a subscription!
Imagine falling asleep to soft rain in an Oregon coastal rainforest, waves on a pebble beach, South African crickets, a warm crackling campfire, or enchanting wind chimes.
Or … if you prefer the steady hum of 'white noise’, fall asleep to a steady blizzard, a flowing glacial stream, or pure white and pink noise.
You will fall asleep fast and wake up feeling refreshed and rejuvenated.
What's more, Soothing Sleep Sounds can be used anytime you need to block out the outside world:
• Increase your ability to focus and be creative at work by removing distractions.
• Soothe your baby or small children and create a peaceful sanctuary for you and your family.
• Transform your hotel room into a familiar sleep oasis by blocking out noisy neighbors, ice machines, and elevator doors.
• Create a calm and tranquil environment for meditation and yoga.
With 300 high-quality audio tracks to choose from, you can fine-tune a collection of sounds to your individual taste. 
And if that isn't enough, you can create your own personalized mixes for sleep, work, travel, nap time, or meditation, blending up to 6 sounds at a time.
Soothing Sleep Sounds includes for FREE: Over 125 high-quality stereo recordings, unlimited 6-sound mixes, and an auto-shutoff timer.
Subscribe to get over 300 high-quality sounds, all future sound additions, and no ads.
Improve your sleep, your health, and your sense of well-being starting tonight.

• 125 natural sounds recorded on location around the world (over 300 with subscription)
• Long high-quality stereo recordings
• Easy-to-create blended mixes of any 6 sounds
• Beautiful high-definition images from around the globe
• Modern easy-to-use interface, tailored for nighttime use
• Sleep timer with slow audio fade-out, settable with a simple tap
• Easy search functions to discover your favorite sounds
• Runs in background while using other apps or when the screen is locked
• Mixes with other sound apps such as Music or Audiobooks
• 19 sounds categories, including Rain, Ocean, Rivers & Streams, Crickets & Insects, Frogs, Wind Chimes, Lakes, Wind, Water Fountains, Fire, Birds, Animals, Cars, Trains, Public Places, Household, Bells, Industrial, Soundscapes

bluejetty:00122783:ios.description:
Fuel Monitor is your assistant to help keeping an eye on the cost for cars: fuels, charging, services, repairs and other fees. Just add the miles, gallons and cost, it could calculate the fuel economy for gasoline car, and energy consumption for electric car automatically, which would help you save your money and time.
Set the services interval, it would intelligently list the due date or odometer of each maintenance in schedule.
Key Features:
Vehicles
⁃ Supports multiple vehicles.
⁃ Manage basic info of your cars: VIN, Plate, Tire Size and engine type etc.
⁃ Track expense for each vehicle separately.
Fuels
⁃ Calculate fuel consumption automatically.
⁃ Calculate cost per mile/km.
⁃ Track fuel logs including fuel-up, price, total cost, date, odometer, location, etc.
Energies
⁃ Calculate energy consumption automatically.
⁃ Calculate cost per mile/km.
⁃ Track charging logs including reading, price, total cost, date, percentage after charging, location, etc.
Services
⁃ Track kinds of services’ logs including odometer, time, cost, labor cost and note.
⁃ Default and custom service types and maintenance interval.
⁃ Set time of in advance reminding by days or odometer.
⁃ List the next due date/odometer of each service type. 
Repairs
⁃ Track kinds of repairs logs including odometer, time, cost, labor cost and note.
⁃ Default and Custom repair expense types.
Other fees
⁃ Track kinds of other fees, such as parking, washing, decorating, insurance, etc. 
⁃ Default and Custom other expense types.
Powerful reports
⁃ Pie chart to show cost & percentage of fuel, service, repair and other expenses.
⁃ Bar chart to show the cost of fuels/energy, service, repair and other expenses by week, month, year or custom.
⁃ Pie chart to show the cost & percentage of each service/repair/other expense type by week, month, year or custom.
⁃Table to list fuel statistics, including average fuel economy, avg cost per mile/km, total miles and etc.
⁃ Line graph to show the trend of fuel economy and cost per mile/km.
⁃ Line graph to show recent fuel price trend.
⁃ Line graph to show recent fuel/energy cost.
⁃ Line graph to show recent service cost.
⁃ Line graph to show recent repair cost.
⁃ Line graph to show recent other cost.
Extra highlight
⁃ Clean and tidy UI. 
⁃ Calendar overview of data.
⁃ Supports maps to track location info.
⁃ Supports both US and SI unit.
⁃ Supports backup & restore through iCloud and Dropbox.
⁃ Export data by email in format of PDF, CSV & HTML.
⁃ Supports Printing data directly by this app.
⁃ Supports importing data from a CSV file.
⁃ Supports customizing the digital decimal of cost, fuel economy, etc.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch.
⁃ Supports universal version (available on both iPhone and iPad).
Please contact us by email for any feedback or suggestion: linklinksapp@tom.com.

bluejetty:00096663:ios.description:
Free to download and play. Optional in-app purchases are available for Gold and other premium content.
You can Graduate. Hustle. Fall in love. Get rich. Go broke. Start over. Your entire life — from age 18 ‘til the day you die — is in your hands. Start from Nothing — or Everything.
Spin the wheel to discover your family background: Born rich? Blessed. Broke? Prove the world wrong. Every player begins differently — but success is never guaranteed.
Go to Real Colleges. Get Real Degrees.
Choose real universities, pay tuition, take classes, and earn grades in a Trivia Crack-style gameplay that decides your GPA, career options, and life path. Flunk out or graduate with honors — it’s up to you.
Work Hard, Get Paid, Stay Afloat
Get hired, promoted, fired, or even sued. Pay rent, loans, and utilities — or end up in collections. Buy cars, houses, yachts, pets, or go bankrupt chasing luxury. Every decision changes your net worth, credit score, and future opportunities.
Love, Lust & Life Choices
Meet NPC friends and partners who live across America. Date, flirt, break up, get engaged, or get married — for love or convenience. Real choices. Real consequences. Real drama.
Travel the World — or Stay Home and Hustle
Visit over 100 countries. Party in Ibiza. Work remotely from Tokyo. Escape debt in Thailand. Every trip opens new storylines, career paths, and global status boosts.
Build Your Dream Life
Shop thousands of real-world inspired items — cars, clothes, real estate, and luxuries. Adopt pets, collect assets, decorate your space, and flex your lifestyle online.
Age, Legacy & Leaderboards
Live from 18 to 90+. Climb the leaderboard for status, net worth, and social influence. When it’s over, you’ll get your gravestone — and your life story. Who were you, really?
Why Players Everywhere Love It
* Ultra-realistic life simulation with humor & heart
* Endless storylines, thousands of outcomes
* Real colleges, real degrees, real world logic
* Choices that matter — from love to loans
* Compete globally for the top life score
Your Life Starts Now
From broke dreamer to billionaire, from dropout to CEO — your story begins here. Download Livin: America and see how far your choices can take you.
Who are you, really?

Becoming a dentist can be a fun and rewarding career! With this entertaining mouth doctor game, you get a chance to see what dentists do in their practice. Spray the mouth with water to rinse away harmful bacteria.
Remove excess candy from teeth with a small dental grinder.
Clean teeth using a special pick to remove plaque around the gums.
Remove pus from swollen areas to help gums heal.

Use a special light to eliminate floating bacteria in the mouth.
Pull out black rotten teeth with dental pliers before replacing them with new, clean teeth.
Use a dental vacuum to suck water from the patient’s mouth so they can talk.
Repair broken teeth with a drill for a better smile.
Remove all floating bacteria in the mouth using a microscope.
Add color or patterns to patients’ teeth for a stylish look.

bluejetty:00187022:ios.description:
Our Ziraat Mobile application, which provides convenient and practical access to banking transactions, offers many innovations to our Individual, Corporate and Corporate monitoring customers with its easy, understandable and user-friendly interfaces.
• With the monitoring infrastructure created for our young customers aged 15-18, they can use Ziraat Mobile with the authority to monitor.
• Within the scope of their authority, our corporate customers can view and approve their pending transactions from the Approval Management information panel in Ziraat Mobile application. Our corporate monitoring customers can use Ziraat Mobile with monitoring authority.
• Through the information panels on the main page; You can easily access many information / basic products / transactions such as Accounts/Cards, Upcoming Instructions, Last Transactions, Financial Agenda and personalize these information panels according to your own needs and frequency of use with the Home Page Editing function in the Profile and Settings menu. Thanks to the advanced search feature on the homepage, you can easily access the transactions you want to perform.
• Click on the "Check out the tips now!" section to view our personalized recommendations for you.
• By adding your favorite menus to my shortcuts, you can perform your operations as you wish.
• All your investment-related transactions can be managed through our Investment menu.
• With the Portfolio menu, you can view detailed information about all your investment products and track your historical asset allocation details. You can compare the past performance returns of the investment products you follow.
• With Ziraat Mobile Plus of Life, you can easily access services related to your car, home, family, business, and travel.
• You can easily access our other applications through the Application Market.
• With the Quick Transfer feature, you can save your frequently transferred Money Transfer / EFT transactions, and then complete the recorded transaction in one step.
• You can make your money transfer/EFT/FAST transactions to another account quickly and easily by reading IBAN with your camera or by selecting the photo containing IBAN from your gallery.
• You can get instant notifications on money in and out of your account by updating your notification feature and information preference settings.
• You can apply without having to go to the branch from the applications menu, and you can follow the status of your applications.
• You can make your insurance, retirement, invoice and corporate payments from Ziraat Mobil and you can have DASK to protect your property against earthquake risk.
• You can easily pay your tax debt by making inquiries with multiple options thanks to the easy tax payment menu or by reading the barcode with your phone's camera thanks to the barcode scanning feature.
• With QR Code Transactions, you can make withdrawals / deposits from our ATMs without your card.
• You can add your profile photo to Ziraat Mobile application.
• Our customers, whose security preference is Ziraat Approve, can log in to Ziraat mobile application more securely with Fingerprint or Face Recognition. With the Remember Me feature, Customer No / T.C. You can save your ID number, and you can login with your password only in the next login.
Without the need to login to Ziraat Mobile application;
• With the Make an Appointment feature, you can create your appointment without going to the branch and perform your transactions without waiting in the branch.
• Thanks to the Nearest Ziraat, you can easily reach the locations of all branches and ATMs and get directions if needed.
• You can access our Bank and Market data instantly from the Financial Data field.
• With the Improved Calculation tools, you can calculate the plan of the loan you plan to receive or how much your deposit will bring.
Have a nice day.

bluejetty:00084132:ios.description:
### PLEASE NOTE ### : This is a 100% UNOFFICIAL community-driven guide and utility app designed solely to help players improve their in-game skills. 
It is NOT the game itself, nor is it affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by KRAFTON, Inc. or PUBG Corporation.
Whether you are a beginner looking to understand the basics or a veteran aiming for the top ranks, Guide & Stat for PUBG New State provides you with the deep insights, real-time data, and tactical knowledge you need to win.
• WEAPONS & STATS (Master Your Firepower)
Know your weapon's close, mid, and long-range behaviors. Find the perfect weapons and attachments tailored to your personal playstyle and spray control. 
• RECOIL MECHANISM (Precision Training)
Stop guessing and start hitting your targets. Understand exactly how different attachments alter your weapon’s recoil mechanism to perfect your spray charts and bullet drops.
• OFFICIAL STAT TRACKER (Analyze & Improve)
Understanding your lifetime game stats is crucial to your growth. Track your own, your friends', or any player's lifetime performance fetched directly from the official PUBG API. 
*(Note: To ensure fair usage and server stability, a limit of 10 requests per minute applies to all users, including Pro subscribers).*
• MAPS & LANDING ZONES (Drop Like a Pro)
Gain total map control in competitive play. Explore every landing zone, analyzing its popularity, risk factor, and high-tier loot distribution across all maps. 
• BESTS AND WORSTS (Quick Comparisons)
No time to read heavy charts? View the best and worst weapon stats instantly with intuitive, color-coded indicators designed for fast comparison.
• CLOTHES & SKINS (The Battleground Lookbook)
Browse the complete collection of outfits and weapon skins. Check drop rates, rarities, high-quality images, and discover exactly how to unlock them.
• VEHICLES (Your Escape Plan)
Every vehicle detailed. Know their health, top speeds, and fuel capacities so you always have the perfect rotation strategy.
IMPORTANT LEGAL NOTICE:
• This application is an UNOFFICIAL guide, stat tracker, and companion tool intended solely for educational and informational purposes to assist players.
• This app does NOT offer any in-game cheats, hacks, modifications, or automation tools. It cannot alter or interact with the game PUBG New State.
• All in-game content, imagery, text, and data related to PUBG New State are copyrighted by their respective owners. Safe usage of these educational assets falls under fair use guidelines.
• This application uses data from the official PUBG API but is NOT officially endorsed or certified by the API provider.
LEGAL DISCLAIMER:
This is a fan-made application developed independently for the iOS and macOS community. This app is NOT the PUBG or PLAYERUNKNOWN'S BATTLEGROUNDS game itself! This is an UNOFFICIAL community-driven guide and has NO affiliation, endorsement, or sponsorship with the official game or its publishers. All game names, images, characters, logos, and other details are not created by us but by their respective owners. This app is intended for educational and informational purposes only, aiming to help players improve their skills.
ABOUT SUBSCRIPTIONS:
Cancel subscription anytime. Subscription automatically renews unless AUTO-RENEW is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period by going to your iOS Account Settings after purchase. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period at the price of the annual, monthly, or weekly subscription depending on what is chosen. bluejetty:00083646:ios.description:
The sudden madness of an old friend from the Lost Lands forces Susan, who has long since retired, to return to her old adventures.
“Lost Lands X” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests. 
Susan Shepard has long decided that she is done with traveling to the Lost Lands and found herself in writing. However, the recent events in the Lost Lands have decided otherwise. Susan's best friend Folnur has gone crazy and killed old Maaron! What has changed in Folnur? Who or what forced these changes? This time, Susan will have to solve a problem not of universal importance, but important for herself. Susan will again go back in time to understand the reasons for what happened. On the way, she will meet old friends who will unite into a team. However, an old enemy will appear, whom Susan will never suspect to return. All the puzzles from the past and the present will come together in this story!
- Return to the Lost Lands as Susan the Warmaiden once again!
- Unravel the mystery of the old friend's madness and help to defeat his demons!
- Visit the Halfling Fair! Perhaps you will find help in this unexpected place to solve your problems.
- Solve fun and logical, easy and difficult, fast and long puzzles to move forward in the story!
- Go back to the past again! There lies the source of the current catastrophe.
The game is optimized for tablets and phones!

Word Jigsaw: Brain Teaser is an incredibly addictive and entertaining word puzzle game created by the masterminds behind the popular Brain Test and Popular Words games! Get ready to experience a unique twist on traditional word games with our innovative drag-and-drop mechanics. It's a perfect blend of word challenges and jigsaw puzzles that will keep you engaged for hours. The game presents you with a series of words that have been cleverly broken into jigsaw pieces. This captivating game has been crafted by the ingenious developers behind the critically acclaimed Brain Test and the widely renowned Popular Words.
HOW TO PLAY Word Jigsaw: Brain Teaser

bluejetty:00033913:ios.description:
CAR FOR SALE SIMULATOR 2023: REALISTIC CAR TRADE AND OPEN-WORLD SIMULATION
Car for Sale Simulator 2023 offers a realistic experience of car buying and selling, modification, high-speed races, and more in an open-world simulation. Experience a complete simulation by trading vehicles in a dynamic world!
OVER 70 REALISTIC VEHICLES AND COUNTLESS MODIFICATION COMBINATIONS
Car for Sale Simulator 2023 offers more than 70 vehicles to choose from. Explore the performance features and design of each car, from sports cars to classic models. Modify your vehicles and give them a new look with customization options.
DYNAMIC OPEN-WORLD SIMULATION
Trade in a vast and dynamic open-world simulation. Apply your trading strategies and discover new opportunities around every corner. This open world allows you to experience all aspects of vehicle management.
CAR TRADING SYSTEM IN A LIVING WORLD
Trade cars in a living world. Enjoy a dynamic and realistic trading experience with vehicle evaluation and auction mechanics. Seize every opportunity and apply your strategies. The in-game world offers constantly changing challenges and opportunities, enriching the trading experience.
VEHICLE EVALUATION AND AUCTION SYSTEMS
Determine the value of vehicles with a comprehensive evaluation system and auction mechanics. Find rare vehicles or showcase your own collection. This system allows you to refine your trading strategy.
REALISTIC CAR ACCIDENT AND REPAIR SYSTEM
Respond to accidents and prepare your vehicles for the road again with realistic accident and repair systems. The repair process after an accident makes your simulation experience even more realistic.
CAR PAINTING AND MODIFICATION OPTIONS
Modify and customize your vehicles with the painting system to give them a fresh look. Modification and painting options offer plenty of opportunities to enhance performance and personalization.
HIGH-SPEED RACING, DRAG, AND DRIFT EVENTS
Test your driving skills on high-speed race tracks, in drag races, and drift events. These events allow you to experience the dynamic and exciting aspects of Car for Sale Simulator 2023. Perform your best in different race types and satisfy your need for speed.
VEHICLE MAINTENANCE: FUEL, WASHING, AND TABLET SYSTEMS
Refuel your vehicles, use car washing systems, and manage all processes with the tablet system. These systems enhance the realism of the game and make vehicle management easier.
CUSTOMIZATION, TUNING, AND UPGRADES
Personalize and optimize your vehicles with various customization options. Tune engines, brakes, and exhaust systems to succeed in drag races, drift events, and other simulation challenges.
SKILL TREE SYSTEM
Develop your skills in vehicle modifications, trading strategies, and precise car parking maneuvers with an advanced skill tree system. Unlock abilities to master parking challenges, reduce damage during drives, improve bargaining, and enhance your overall progression – making the game even more enjoyable and rewarding!
CAR FOR SALE SIMULATOR 2023: A REALISTIC TRADING AND SIMULATION EXPERIENCE AWAITS YOU
Car for Sale Simulator 2023 offers players a complete vehicle trading and simulation experience. Customize your vehicles, improve your trading strategies, and test your limits in a realistic simulation world. Download Car for Sale Simulator 2023 for free now and enjoy the thrill of car trading!

Confused choosing between multiple options? Spin the wheel and make choices!
Spin the wheel is a random picker app that allows you to make choices by spinning the roulette wheel. All you have to do is create a wheel, enter your favorable options, customize the style/color, and start spinning. Voila, you got the result.
Whether you’ve hosted a giveaway and want a “random name picker” app to pick the winner or just want an app that’ll help you decide what to eat/drink or wear, where to go, who will pay, etc. Just create a wheel, enter the options, and get your choice.
-- Features --
‣ Readymade wheels for popular questions.
‣ Purely random choices (no logical restrictions)
‣ Modern UI & Wheel Designs.
‣ Feels like spinning a roulette manually.
‣ Works on iPhone & iPad.
‣ History & Results access.
‣ Hide won slice (Premium feature)
‣ Share the winner details on social media.
‣ Limitless wheel customization.
Our research team found out some of the most popular questions like “What to eat?”, “What to wear?”, “Yes/No”, etc and have included them inside the app. That said, you can customize them or even clone the wheels to add your own options.
If you don’t want to use the ready-made wheels, then you can create your own custom wheel, choose the wheel style, color theme, add your own options, customize the wheel settings such as changing text size, spin time, repeating slices, etc and start spinning.
-- Unlimited Customization of the Wheel --
You can customize the text size, repeat slices x times, change the wheel style, colors of the slices, spin time, turn on/off fair mode, change the values of slices, shuffle the slices, change the slice colors, etc.
Isn’t it amazing? Not only would the app help you find the right choice, but you can customize the appearance in such a way that you have no other option but to agree with the results.
What are you waiting for? Install the Spin the wheel app now and make perfect random choices now!

bluejetty:00133611:ios.description:
Welcome to the BPI app!
Managing your money has never been easier. Access your accounts, transfer funds, pay bills, invest, and more, wherever you are. The BPI app gives you secure and convenient banking right at your fingertips.
FREE TRANSFERS TO BANKS AND E-WALLETS
Easily transfer money between your BPI accounts, send money to other BPI accounts, or transfer funds to other local banks and e-wallets via PesoNet and InstaPay for free. Save time by setting up Favorites for frequently used recipients.
PAY BILLS ANYTIME
Settle bills anytime with thousands of billers to choose from. Schedule recurring payments ahead of time so you never miss a due date.
PAY WITH QR PH
Skip the cash-in and pay directly from your BPI account. Simply scan any QR Ph code at participating merchants.
UNDERSTAND YOUR SPENDING BETTER
Get personalized insights based on your transactions and app activity to help you manage your spending, make informed financial decisions, and stay on track with your goals.
OPEN AN ACCOUNT IN MINUTES
Open a BPI Savings Account using your National ID and selfie verification. No branch visit required. Once approved, you can immediately access BPI digital banking services.
INVEST AND GROW YOUR MONEY
Grow your wealth and secure your future with BPI investment products. View and manage your investments in one place and conveniently set up or amend your Regular Subscription Plan (RSP) directly in the app. Eligible clients can also access their BPI Privilege Cards and exclusive experiences through the app.
TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR SECURITY
Enjoy added security with customizable transaction limits and Mobile Key authorization. Securely approve transactions using your device's biometric credentials. You can also log in to BPI online on a web browser using the QR Scanner in the app when Mobile Key is unavailable. Manage your cards anytime and enjoy greater control and protection for your everyday banking activities.
BANK WITHOUT VISITING A BRANCH
Access a growing range of services directly in the app:
• Order a Debit Card
• Open a New Account
• Open a Time Deposit Account
• Reorder Checkbooks
• Stop Check Payment Orders
• Download Statements of Account
• Download Wealth Portfolio Statements
• Update Mobile Number
• Manage Trusted Devices
• Temporarily or Permanently Block Debit or Credit Cards
• Check Deposit (available to eligible customers)
• Cardless Withdrawal
• Buy and Sell USD
• Credit-to-Cash and Balance Conversion for eligible customers
• Partner Store Transactions (Deposit or Withdraw)
UNLOCK PERSONALIZED OFFERS
Enjoy exclusive offers, rewards, and promotions available through the BPI app. Receive personalized deals and experiences designed for BPI customers.
ABOUT BPI
As one of the largest banks in the Philippines, The Bank of the Philippine Islands has a long-standing reputation for providing trusted and reliable financial services. Through continuous innovation and digital transformation, BPI delivers secure, convenient, and customer-focused banking solutions that help millions of Filipinos achieve their financial goals. BPI was recognized by FinanceAsia as Best Financial Company and Best Overall Company in the Philippines.
With the BPI app, you can bank with confidence knowing your transactions are protected by robust security features. The app is continuously enhanced with new features and improvements designed to make banking simpler, safer, and more convenient every day.
Download the BPI app and make every day better with BPI.

bluejetty:00170753:ios.description:
With MindZone®'s sleep sounds, white noise & meditation, you will finally get the sleep you need.
MindZone® is an app aimed at helping you sleep and relax better. It offers a sound machine, various sleep sounds, bedtime stories, and sleep meditations to help you create better conditions for a night’s sleep. You even have the option to customize your personal sounds for sleep and improve your physical and mental health, maintain your focus at work better, improve relationships, and more.
Further, MindZone® also provides mindfulness courses, meditation guidance, daily reminders, and more to help you fall asleep, or simply calm down throughout the day. No matter your goals, MindZone® is here to aid in your night’s sleep and deep relaxation.
MindZone® FEATURES:
• Various sleep sounds and white noise options, such as nature sounds like Rain Sounds, Ocean Waves, Waterfalls, Campfire, Thunderstorm, and many more.
• Sound Machine available. Mix and match nature sounds, white noise, and more to create the perfect, personal mix for you.
• Soothing music and bedtime stories for relaxation, focus, and sleep, so that you can improve your physical as well as mental health.
• A series of mindfulness courses to help aid you in achieving specific goals, such as relaxation, self-improvement, and sleep quality.
• Guided meditations led by the world’s top mindfulness experts, to help you relieve your anxious mind, improve your focus, and relationships, and obtain peace.
• 3-minute mini-meditations for when you don’t have time for a longer session, but need a quick mood reset.
• Daily mindfulness reminders, to help bring you back to a calm frame of mind during the day.
MindZone® offers an auto-renewing subscription to get unlimited access to all content in the app:
$59.99 per year
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Meditation for mental health, and sleep for physical health, this is the ultimate self-care app. Inner peace, happiness, mindfulness, and more, there is no limit to the benefits. Download MindZone® today, and treat yourself like the queen or king that you are.

bluejetty:00096177:android.description:
Voggy - AI Video Generator is an advanced AI-powered video generation application designed to help users effortlessly create stunning videos in minutes. Whether you are a content creator, marketer, educator, or social media influencer, Voggy empowers you to turn simple text prompts or images into high-quality, engaging videos without any prior video editing skills.
Voggy - AI Video Generator is a powerful and innovative AI Video Generator application designed to help you create professional, creative, and entertaining videos from images and text in just a few steps. Whether you want to generate dynamic dance videos, creative emoji-based animations, fun hair swaps, or romantic kissing videos, Voggy provides easy-to-use tools powered by advanced artificial intelligence.
AI-Powered Video Generation Generate professional-looking videos automatically by entering text prompts or uploading images. The app leverages powerful artificial intelligence algorithms to interpret your input and produce visually appealing video content.
Image-to-Video Transformation Convert your images into dynamic video clips by applying movement, transitions, effects, and background music. Perfect for creating photo slideshows, promotional videos, or creative presentations.
Predefined Templates and Styles Choose from a wide selection of professionally designed templates and styles to fit different use cases such as marketing promos, educational lessons, product advertisements, social media posts, and more.
Bodyshake Video Generator Transform static images into lively bodyshake videos that simulate natural human movements. Perfect for social media posts, fun content creation, or personal projects where you want to add rhythm and movement to your photos.
Kissing Video Generator Create realistic kissing animation videos from your images. Ideal for romantic video greetings, special surprises, or creative storytelling using personal photos.
Shake It Dance Effect Generate entertaining dance videos by applying shake and dance effects to images or videos. The AI creates synchronized movements based on trending dance styles, allowing you to make attention-grabbing content for platforms.
Hair Swap Function Change hairstyles in photos effortlessly using AI-powered hair swap technology. Choose from a variety of trendy hairstyles and apply them to your images, making it easy to visualize different looks without visiting a salon.
My Photo Emoji Maker Generate animated emoji-based video content by combining your facial expressions or images with creative animated emoji overlays. Add fun, humor, or personal expression to your videos and photos for sharing on messaging platforms and social media.
Features
- Social media influencers seeking creative and unique video content.
- Digital marketers creating eye-catching promotional materials.
- Couples or individuals wanting to create personalized romantic videos.
- Content creators producing fun, viral, or trendy videos.
- Anyone interested in experimenting with AI-powered video effects without complicated tools.
- Advanced AI technology for fully automated video creation.
- Supports multiple unique and trending video effects.
- No need for expensive video editing software or prior experience.
- Regular updates with new effects and features.

bluejetty:00072661:ios.name: Club Boss - Football Game
bluejetty:00072661:ios.summary: Club Boss is an offline football management / soccer management simulation game, where you create your own football club and lead them to glory in the premier division and football cup. Manage your own football club to glory, by buying, sel
bluejetty:00072661:ios.description:
Club Boss is an offline football management / soccer management simulation game, where you create your own football club and lead them to glory in the premier division and football cup. Manage your own football club to glory, by buying, selling and training your wonderkids. Upgrade facilites, manage finances and win trophies in Club Boss!
Build your own football club in Club Boss, the new fast-paced addictive football manager game. Enjoy the Football Chairman-like gameplay and the Football Manager style stats and details.
Start from the bottom of a domestic football league and develop, finance and negotiate your football club to the top of the football pyramid.
CREATE YOUR FOOTBALL CLUB
Create a football club from scratch and start in the most competitive football leagues and cups in the world. Name your club, pick your club colors and select your starting country. Once you start your journey, hire a football manager, sign and sell football players and climb to the top of the football league and add cup trophies along the way, in your own style and at your own pace.
As time passes, players will come and go, but the true legends will always stay visible on the club records menu. Keep track of your most capped player, top goalscorer of all time and most expensive signing and sales. Build your football club with true personality.
START IN YOUR COUNTRY
Create your own club and play in your favorite football competition and dominate the highest division in your country. Playable football competitions include the English Premier League, Italian Serie A, German Bundesliga, American MLS among many, many more!
BUILD YOUR SQUAD
Sign superstars and exciting wonderkids or develop them in your clubs youth system. Club Boss offers multiple ways to build your football clubs squad:
- Sign players for your squad using the transfer market.
- Sign young players for your youth academy.
- Invest in wonderkids and golden generations to give your football club a boost for the future.
- Improve the players in your first team by training and developing their skills.
- Sign the right football manager to win matches and improve your players.
Will you be a true football chairman and focus on your youth team or will you spend to get the best football club in the world?
UPGRADE YOUR INFRASTRUCTURE
Club Boss lets you build your football club by allowing upgrades to your stadium, training center and staff. Increase ticket prices, stadium attendance, trainers and much more. Sign sponsors for your football club to help with finances and invest it on the pitch in your football team.
How will you be upgrading your football club to become the next football empire?
DYNAMIC FOOTBALL WORLD
The football world in Club Boss is completely dynamic. Just as in Football Manager and Football Chairman, club and players will increase and decrease in rating as time passes.
PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Club Boss offers the same fast-pace and addictive gameplay as Football Chairman. Play at your own pace. Build your football empire as slow or fast as you want.
Next to the dozen features to truly lead your football club to glory, there is an intuitive UI which helps guide you lead your club to success as a football chairman.
Good luck on your journey to become the best football chairman in this new fast-paced football manager game: Club Boss. Happy managing!

bluejetty:00185833:ios.name: Brushes
bluejetty:00185833:ios.summary: Brushes 4 is the latest iteration of the app that started the iPhone and iPad painting revolution. Redesigned with a clean and modern user interface, Brushes supports iPhone and iPad with optimisation for the iPhone X, iPhone XS, iPhone Pr
bluejetty:00185833:ios.description:
Brushes 4 is the latest iteration of the app that started the iPhone and iPad painting revolution. Redesigned with a clean and modern user interface, Brushes supports iPhone and iPad with optimisation for the iPhone X, iPhone XS, iPhone Pro and iPad with Apple Pencil.
• Highlights:
- Clean and modern user interface with light and dark modes.
- Files based painting gallery.
- New canvas interface.
- Apple Pencil support with pressure curve.
– Unlimited undo and redo.
- Continuous auto-save.
- Cloud Drive import and export.
• Parameterized Brushes:
- Selection of ready to use brushes with customisable settings.
- Create your own custom brushes from millions of permutations.
- Generate random brushes for inspiration.
- Dynamic adjustment of brush size and opacity.
• Layers:
- Layer your artwork for greater control.
– Lock and hide layers.
– Use alpha lock to only paint where pixels already exist.
– Adjust individual layer opacity.
– Duplicate, rearrange and merge layers.
– Apply layer blending modes: normal, multiply, screen, exclude.
- Color fill any layer.
– Invert layer color and desaturate.
– Flip and arbitrarily transform layers.
– Adjust the color balance per layer.
– Adjust layer hue, saturation and brightness.
• Colors:
- Colour picker with hue ring and saturation square. 
- Store and recall your favourite colors in swatches.
- Sample painting colors with the eyedropper tool.
• Apple Pencil:
- Intuitive and powerful pressure curve to match your style.
- Configurable realtime pressure based adjustment of brush size and opacity.
• Creation:
- Preset canvas sizes for paper, photographs, iPhone and iPad screens, film and television displays.
- Custom canvas size.
• Import, export and sharing:
- Import images directly from your camera roll.
- Import PNG and JPEG images from cloud services.
- Export your paintings for sharing or importing into other apps as PNG and JPEG to all cloud storage services or as photos directly to your camera roll.
- Compatible with paintings created by Brushes 3 and Brushes Redux.
• Light and dark appearances:
- Choose between light and dark monochrome appearances, or current system setting.
- Minimal use of user interface color so that tints in the user interface do not distract from or influence your artwork color choices.
Acknowledgements.
Thank you to Angela Ali, Jason M., Jeff Parker, Sandra Perez and Yoshiyuki Uchida for contributing artwork to the App Store screenshots. Please visit our website to see more of their artwork and for links to their portfolios.
History.
Brushes was originally created by Steve Sprang for iPhone in 2009 and for iPad in 2010. His last version, Brushes 3 was released in 2012, but was removed from the App Store in 2015. I took over development to modernise and support an app that has continued to be enjoyed by so many artists.

– Invert layer color and desaturate.
– Flip and arbitrarily transform layers.
– Adjust the color balance per layer.
– Adjust layer hue, saturation and brightness.

• Colors:
- Colour picker with hue ring and saturation square. 
- Store and recall your favourite colors in swatches.
- Sample painting colors with the eyedropper tool.

• Apple Pencil:
- Intuitive and powerful pressure curve to match your style.
- Configurable realtime pressure based adjustment of brush size and opacity.

• Creation:
- Preset canvas sizes for paper, photographs, iPhone and iPad screens, film and television displays.
- Custom canvas size.

• Import, export and sharing:
- Import images directly from your camera roll.
- Import PNG and JPEG images from cloud services.
- Export your paintings for sharing or importing into other apps as PNG and JPEG to all cloud storage services or as photos directly to your camera roll.
- Compatible with paintings created by Brushes 3 and Brushes Redux.

• Light and dark appearances:
- Choose between light and dark monochrome appearances, or current system setting.
- Minimal use of user interface color so that tints in the user interface do not distract from or influence your artwork color choices.

Acknowledgements.

Thank you to Angela Ali, Jason M., Jeff Parker, Sandra Perez and Yoshiyuki Uchida for contributing artwork to the App Store screenshots.  Please visit our website to see more of their artwork and for links to their portfolios.

History.

Brushes was originally created by Steve Sprang for iPhone in 2009 and for iPad in 2010.  His last version, Brushes 3 was released in 2012, but was removed from the App Store in 2015.  I took over development to modernise and support an app that has continued to be enjoyed by so many artists.

bluejetty:00043234:ios.summary:

Whether you are planning to create an online survey, an online exam, an online poll, or an online qu
bluejetty:00043234:ios.description:
SurveyHeart is committed to making form building an enjoyable and seamless activity from the comfort of your mobile phones and Laptop PCs. 
Whether you are planning to create an online survey, an online exam, an online poll, or an online questionnaire, you can do them all on this easy-to-use online survey tool for Apple iOS. 
You will be impressed with its plethora of features to create custom forms from scratch; from Questions (9 distinct types) to Themes to Templates to Overview to Media Options to Multi-Language support to Download to spreadsheets to Preview & more, it is loaded with all the best-in-class features that users look for in a Form Maker: 
—The Questions feature supports 9 distinct question formats like Short Answer, Long Answer, Email, Number, File Upload, Multiple-choice Checkboxes, Dropdown, Date, Time, & Star Rating. 
—The Themes feature supports both standard & custom themes for use as background images for the forms like Dark Mode. Additionally, it allows the company logo to be added if the form developer is interested in displaying it. The best part is the app will mix and match with the colors in the theme to come out with a visually appealing “Start Survey” button that blends perfectly well into the theme. 
—The Templates feature offers a huge assortment of Templates for simplifying your job of form creation based on categories like Travel, Education, Food, Registration, & Health. 
—The Overview feature helps analyze the responses for making informed decisions; gives access to valuable insights like percentage of participants that selected a particular answer for a closed-ended question. What’s even better is one can also view the data in tabular and graphical depictions (graphs, pie charts & bar graphs). 
—The Attachment/Media Option feature allows form makers to embed images, videos and website URLs within the forms for giving a better context to the respondents. —The Multi-Language feature supports 11 popular languages from across the world. 
—The Download feature offers the capability of exporting users’ responses to spreadsheets in .XLSX, .PDF & .CSV formats for analyzing trends and patterns. 
—The Preview feature allows the users to take a live preview of their forms before they get published online. This enables the design of aesthetically appealing forms that gel well with the end users' mobile devices. 
Made for Apple iOS devices (iPhones & iPads), SurveyHeart is the perfect solution for making online Surveys on the go. Downloadable from the App Store, get this top-rated free mobile app today to build surveys, polls, quizzes, & questionnaires like never before. 
To stay ahead in the race, Survey Heart constantly updates its mobile app experiences with better UI design, new features, & software upgrades. Thanks to the firm’s expert design and mobile app development team —SurveyHeart is the go-to mobile Form App in the industry for making surveys
