bluejetty:00145770:ios.name: Imobzi - CRM e ERP Imobiliário
bluejetty:00145770:ios.summary:
Pra você que já é usuário do Imobzi, baixe agora o App para iOS!
O QUE É O IMOBZI?
O app para Corretores e Imobiliárias mais completo da App Store! Leve seus imóveis e contatos para qualquer lugar, agende visitas, gerencie os seus negócio
bluejetty:00145770:ios.description:
Pra você que já é usuário do Imobzi, baixe agora o App para iOS!
O QUE É O IMOBZI?
O app para Corretores e Imobiliárias mais completo da App Store! Leve seus imóveis e contatos para qualquer lugar, agende visitas, gerencie os seus negócios no funil*, suas locações*, seu financeiro* e muito mais.
O QUE O IMOBZI OFERECE?
ASSINATURA ELETRÔNICA 
• Envie qualquer documento para Assinatura, desde: Autorização de Venda e Locação, Termo de Exclusividade, Proposta e Contrato de Compra e Venda, de Locação, etc.
IMÓVEIS
• Não espere chegar no escritório, cadastre o imóvel no local e publique-o no seu site e portais.
• Obtenha a Autorização de Venda ou Locação através do WhatsApp. Recurso exclusivo!
• Trace a rota até o imóvel pelo Waze ou Google Mapas.
• Tenha os seus imóveis na palma das mãos. Consulte, cadastre e altere de qualquer lugar.
• Compartilhe imóveis pelo WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram,...
CONTATOS
• Acesse seus contatos e fale com eles facilmente através do WhatsApp.
• Seja notificado quando um imóvel ou contato chegar do seu site.
• Contato e Timeline inteligente. Tudo é registrado na Timeline de um Contato, desde uma visita marcada na agenda, um e-mail recebido, uma ligação efetuada e até mesmo uma conversa pelo WhatsApp.
AGENDA & GERENCIAMENTO DE NEGÓCIOS
• Milhares de negócios são perdidos por falta de interação do Corretor com um Contato. 
• No Imobzi, nós damos poder de gestão ao Corretor, assim ele pode rapidamente retornar uma ligação, remarcar uma visita ou enviar novos imóveis por e-mail.
• Não corra risco de perder o negócio. No local da visita, obtenha a assinatura do Termo de Visitas pelo WhatsApp.
• Gerencie seus Negócios através de etapas no Funil de Negócios, alertas visuais serão exibidos e você pode tomar uma ação sempre que um contato não receber retorno. Não perca mais negócios!
• Tenha a sua agenda na palma da mão e sincronizada com o Google Agenda.
DASHBOARD & GRÁFICOS
• Tenha uma Dashboard com tudo que você precisa. Gráficos são extremamente poderosos para identificar o que ocorre no seu negócio. Tenha uma visão completa ao abrir o Imobzi.
• Obtenha dados de acesso do Google Analytics dentro do Imobzi.
INTEGRAÇÃO COM E-MAIL
• Na integração com e-mail você envia um e-mail e fica sabendo na hora quando um Contato abriu e quantas vezes ele abriu.
• Utilize os + de 40 modelos de textos disponíveis e responda facilmente ao comprador, proprietário ou locatário. Economize tempo!
• Integre com MailChimp e automatize o envio de seus e-mails de Marketing.
GESTÃO DE LOCAÇÃO
• Tenha uma Gestão de Locação automática. O Imobzi envia o boleto para o Inquilino pagar o aluguel todos os meses.
• Após o recebimento do aluguel, o Imobzi repasse o dinheiro automaticamente para o proprietário e emite a Nota Fiscal da taxa de administração.
• Ele também gera a DIMOB para você não precisar lançar manualmente.
• Quer mais? Conheça a Imobiliária Digital e tenha o processo de locação todo online, desde a contratação da garantia até a assinatura eletrônica do contrato.
FINANCEIRO
• Financeiro completo para quem trabalha somente com vendas ou com locação.
• Gerencie suas Contas à Pagar/Receber e visualize o Fluxo de Caixa.
• Faça facilmente a conciliação bancária utilização a integração com o PJBank ou importando o arquivo ".ofx".
RELATÓRIOS
• Relatórios gerenciais de Conversão de negócios, Negócios Ganhos, Novos Negócios, Negócios Perdidos, Progresso, Velocidade, Planejamento de mídia e Gráfico de captações.
REDE SOCIAL DE NEGÓCIOS & CHAT
• Fale, compartilhe imóveis e contatos com outros usuários do Imobzi em qualquer lugar do Brasil através do easyChat e da Rede Social de Negócios. Monte também a sua Rede.

bluejetty:00127162:ios.description:
Brand NEW and Completely FREE Solitaire Play! Classic Patience Card Game at its BEST and most EXCITING! New to Solitaire? Klondike veteran? We got you covered! 
52 cards, 4 suits, 1 goal - Play and Win! It's as classic of the game as you can find with quite a bit of new and amazing features. Sit back, relax and enjoy the soothing gameplay of Solitaire Play on your mobile phone and/or your tablet. We promised you the best and we are intended to deliver!
Unfamiliar with Klondike Solitaire rules? There you go ;-)
The goal of this game is to sort cards by suit in ascending order, Ace to King, Hearts, Spades, Cross, and Diamonds. Set up and rules are what makes it challenging and exciting. You've got cards on the table in seven columns, 1 to 7 cards, with only one at the very bottom opened, and the rest of the cards is in the deck. All in completely random order. You can put cards over each other in descending order (Queen over King, 6 over 7, 10 over Jack, etc.) AND of an opposite color only (Hearts and Diamonds over Spades and Crosses, Spades and Crosses over Hearts and Diamonds). You can take cards from deck 1 or 3 at a time if there are no moves you can make at the table as is.
Theory is all and well, but it's WAY more fun to learn Klondike Patience as you go. Download NOW and give it a try :-)
Check out our awesome Solitaire Game Features: 
- Classic Klondike Solitaire. Sort the cards by their suits in the gameplay that already conquered millions of hearts and isn't going to stop there.
- Play this card game for Free. Unlock premium experience with VIP Subscription! Play away!
- No network required. The game is perfect for commutes and is playable in places with no WiFi network.
- Are you Left-Handed? No problem at all! Our game features Left-Hand mode, just for you! 
- Beautiful HD graphics. Play Card Patience at its most gorgeous with the most advanced of screen resolutions.
- Get the highest possible score by completing Klondike game in the least moves and using the least time possible!
- Unlimited free undos and hints. Second thoughts about the move? Undo it! Hard time figuring out what to do? Tap for a hint!
- Drag or Tap. You can play Solitaire game either by dragging & dropping cards OR if you want to, just double-tap the card and it will take the available spot :-D
- Autocomplete. Are you on the finish line and don't wanna bother making obvious moves? Press autocomplete! Problem = solved!
- Klondike Solitaire Draw 1 or 3 cards. Two distinct styles for two types of players. Are you a 1 card draw person or a 3 card draw person?
- Customizable card faces, card backs, and backgrounds. Harvest them all and make this Klondike Patience truly yours!
- And so much more! 
Solitaire Play is a perfect card game for veterans looking for something new and exciting AND is the best Klondike Patience app for the newcomers. Play Solitaire on your commute, in the quiet of your living room and... yeah, we know exactly where you will play it also.
Wave your boredom goodbye with Solitaire Play - the best free Klondike Patience around! Download, play and WIN!
*The game is free to play. The subscription allows the removal of ads and gives access to additional card-back cosmetics.
By downloading this application, you are accepting Terms of Service & Privacy Policy:
http://murka.com/#terms-of-service
http://murka.com/#privacy-policy

bluejetty:00148911:ios.description:
Find cheap bus travel with OurBus, the convenient bus app for booking intercity trips across the United States. Search routes, compare schedules, book bus tickets online, manage your trip, and keep your boarding pass right on your phone.
BOOK BUS TICKETS WITH EASE
Looking for bus tickets for your next city-to-city trip? OurBus makes bus booking simple from start to finish. Choose your origin and destination, select your travel date, find your preferred departure, and book your seat in just a few taps. With digital tickets and mobile boarding passes, your bus travel is paperless and convenient.
FIND CHEAP BUS TICKETS & GREAT VALUE
Find affordable fares for popular routes across the United States. OurBus helps you discover cheap bus tickets and convenient departure options without the hassle of driving, parking, or managing a complicated itinerary. Plus, you can save $15 on every ride you book using the SuperSaver Pass. Check available trips, choose the option that works for you, and book bus tickets directly in the app.
LIVE BUS TRACKING & TRIP UPDATES
Stay informed before and during your trip with live bus tracking. See the location of your bus when tracking is available, and receive important updates about delays, schedule changes, or stop information through app notifications and text messages. With OurBus, the information you need for your journey stays in one place.
COMFORTABLE INTERCITY BUS TRAVEL
Travel between cities with comfortable onboard amenities designed to make your journey easier. Depending on the service, amenities can include reclining seats, free Wi-Fi, charging ports, bottled water, and restrooms.
POPULAR BUS ROUTES
OurBus connects travelers across hundreds of routes and more than 100 bus stops. Popular travel corridors include:
• New York to Boston
• New York to Philadelphia
• New York to Washington, DC
• New York to Baltimore
• New York to Binghamton
• New York to State College
• Chicago to Madison
• New York to Ithaca 
• New York to Buffalo
• Syracuse to New York 
• New York to Atlantic City
• Boston to New York
• Boston to Albany
• Boston to Ithaca
• Washington, DC to New York
• Philadelphia to New York
Route availability, schedules, stops, and service can vary by date and demand.
MANAGE YOUR TRIP ON THE GO
Your OurBus account makes it easy to access upcoming trips, view your booking details, manage reservations, and keep your digital boarding pass available while you travel. Check your trip information whenever you need it, directly from the bus app.
MADE FOR STUDENTS AND WEEKEND TRIPS
Heading home for the break, visiting family, or escaping the city for a few days? Our campus routes connect university towns like Ithaca, State College, Blacksburg, Ann Arbor and College Station to major hubs, so an affordable seat is never far away. Book bus tickets online in advance for holiday weekends, when the best departures fill up first.
WHY TRAVEL WITH OURBUS?
• Book bus tickets online in a few simple steps
• Find affordable fares across hundreds of routes
• Keep your digital boarding pass on your phone
• Use live bus tracking when available
• Get important trip and stop updates
• Travel with convenient onboard amenities
• Manage your booking from your phone
• Explore popular destinations across the United States
Whether you are commuting between cities, visiting family, planning a weekend getaway, or taking a longer trip, OurBus makes intercity bus travel easier from booking to arrival.
Download OurBus and make your next bus trip simple, comfortable, and connected.

bluejetty:00016616:ios.name: KaraFun: Karaoke, Battle, Quiz
bluejetty:00016616:ios.summary: KaraFun brings karaoke, singing game Battle and music quizzes to your iPhone & iPad! Access a vast library of songs, sing your favorite tracks with friends, score your voice and add a fun twist to your sessions with engaging music quizzes.
bluejetty:00016616:ios.description:
KaraFun brings karaoke, singing game Battle and music quizzes to your iPhone & iPad! Access a vast library of songs, sing your favorite tracks with friends, score your voice and add a fun twist to your sessions with engaging music quizzes. Whether you’re belting out hits or testing your musical knowledge, the fun never stops!
— Free — 
Enjoy access to a selection of free songs, one free quiz, and previews of premium tracks from our catalog. Try out all available features, and explore our apps on all your devices for a complete karaoke experience.
— Premium —
Unlock the full catalog of songs, karaoke and battle, music quiz, sync your favorites for offline use, create custom playlists, and personalize your experience by adjusting vocal volumes, key, and tempo to suit your style.
— Pro —
You get everything from the premium plan—full access to songs, music quiz, offline sync, custom playlists, and vocal adjustments—along with additional benefits tailored for businesses, such as a commercial license, a permanent QR code for seamless access, and advanced branding and party control features.
— Features —
- Sing:
Experience the best in karaoke with uninterrupted, ad-free sessions, studio-quality sound, and access to a premium catalog of songs. Discover tracks shared by the community and even enjoy your favorite songs offline for the ultimate convenience.
- Sing & Play with Battle: 
Enjoy our singing game to challenge your friends and score your voice thanks to real-time scoring. 
- Play with Quiz:
Immerse yourself in the world of quizzes and challenge your friends to test your musical knowledge. With the interlude feature, enjoy short musical breaks that make each quiz even more dynamic and engaging. Every quiz provides a fresh and unique experience!
- Control:
Take full control of your karaoke experience with customizable key and tempo settings, adjustable instrumental and vocal tracks volumes, and the ability to personalize the singer’s name. Easily manage everything with remote control from your phone, and keep the party going with seamless background music.
- Organize:
Organize your perfect karaoke session by creating custom playlists, adding songs to your favorites, and enjoying automatic catalog updates. Effortlessly managed the song queue to keep the party flowing smoothly. 
- Vocal Match:
Analyze your voice and match it against thousands of songs to find your perfect matches. Discover which tracks suit your unique vocal style!
- Offline mode:
Hosting a karaoke party in the boondocks? KaraFun's got you covered even when there's no internet. Sync your favorite songs and quizzes offline and keep the fun going! 
- Inputs:
Enhance your setup with our user-friendly input system, allowing you to easily plug in microphones, enjoy simplified controls, efficiently manage inputs, and benefit from a space-saving design for a smoother, more consistent experience.
- Cast to AirPlay / External Screen:
Easily connect your device to any AirPlay-compatible system, or directly to a video projector or TV using an HDMI or USB-C cable. Enjoy the most compact yet powerful karaoke setup for guaranteed party success!
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

■ Tiny Cafe, a cute and cozy cafe game featuring cat customers and winner of the 2024 BIC Best Casual Game Award, has officially launched!
A new cozy cafe game from the developers of Forest Island, a relaxing animal game downloaded by 7 mi
bluejetty:00081989:ios.description:
■ Tiny Cafe, a cute and cozy cafe game featuring cat customers and winner of the 2024 BIC Best Casual Game Award, has officially launched!
A new cozy cafe game from the developers of Forest Island, a relaxing animal game downloaded by 7 million players who love beautiful nature and animals!
[Game Introduction]
1. Run your own cafe for free!
Open and run a cafe with Dolce, the world's smallest barista mouse, and the cat Gusto.
Brew drip coffee with beans from Gusto's own roastery.
The aromatic smell of coffee will attract cats to your cafe.
2. A casual idle simulation cooking game that's easy to play and simple to learn.
Leave the cute staff to their own devices to work hard brewing coffee.
The showcase will automatically fill with freshly baked donuts.
Install new tools such as espresso machines, ovens, and more, and add cakes and other items to the menu.
3. Serve coffee to cat customers
Treat cat customers to heart-melting hot coffee and sweet treats.
Make sure they like your cafe and become regulars.
Enjoy additional stories of your regulars along with their daily or special menu orders on Catbook, the feline social network.
4. Cute part-timers working hard to create your menu items
Watch as cute little mice scurry around making espressos, lattes, and other drinks and desserts.
Set up various rest areas, like a bathhouse, and earn Cheese when staff use them.
Collect Cheese to hire more staff and grow your cafe.
5. 30+ managers with different skills at each grade to help you run your cafe
Call in a special manager with the special delivery service.
If you're lucky, you'll get a top-tier Platinum-grade manager with 4 stars.
When you put managers in your cafe who have a good synergy with each other, your cafe will grow even faster!
6. Go global!
Gather a loyal customer base and harness word of mouth on social media to expand your cafe to cities like New York, Paris, Hawaii, Seoul, Tokyo, and more.
Become a global franchise brand like many you know from the human world.
With a trusted manager and well-trained part-timers, your cafe dreams will certainly come true.
7. Soothing cafe music
Enjoy cafe music from the developers of the global hit, Forest Island.
Listen to them and you'll feel refreshed after a tiring day or a depressing mood.
[Official Instagram]
Follow Tiny Cafe's official Instagram for special events, announcements, free merchandise, and more.
https://www.instagram.com/tinycafe_dolce
■ If one of the following sounds like you, we recommend Tiny Cafe!
- Love coffee and sweets
- Want to run a cute cafe
- Want to get to know cat customers
- Dream of becoming a barista or pastry chef
- Want to learn how to make cafe menu items
- Enjoy cafe music or ASMR
- Love a relaxed cafe atmosphere
- Want to grow a small, independent cafe into a global franchise
- Want to play a cozy idle game, growth game, or simulation game
- Play tycoon games, food games, cooking games, and restaurant games
- Enjoy cute animal games and cat games
- Love manga and anime with stories
- Enjoy interactive story games
Tiny Cafe, a cute, cozy cafe game with cat customers,
Join Dolce, the world's smallest barista, and Gusto the cat, and serve cats coffee!
----

https://nanalistudios.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portals

As featured in Forbes, Insider, and Yahoo, Cuddlytails is a comprehensive pet care provider bringing together a trusted network of vet assistant, pet sitters, and dog walkers to ensure your pet’s overall health and well-being. From 24/7 AI veterinarian assistant consultations to scheduling pet care services for your furry baby, we have it all covered for you!
CONNECT WITH OUR INTELLIGENT VIRTUAL ASSISTANT TO GET EXPERT CARE GUIDANCE ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
At Cuddlytails, you can:
- Chat with an AI Vetcare assistant online 24/7.
- Connect with 5-star-rated and pre-verified sitters or walkers.
- Schedule pet sitting, dog walking, pet check-ins, or dog daycare.
- Get nutritional insights and custom recipes for your pet
- Provide pet care services in your neighborhood.
Download the Cuddlytails application to discover comprehensive pet care solutions tailored to your pet's unique needs and connect with pet-loving neighbors.
24/7 AI VET CARE SERVICES
- Connect with our intelligent virtual assistant instantly to get expert care guidance and peace of mind anytime, anywhere.
BOARDING & SITTING PET CARE SERVICES
- Connect with trusted and pre-verified pet sitters and dog walkers in your neighborhood and schedule dog/cat boarding, dog/cat sitting, dog walking, dog/cat check-in, or doggy daycare for your furry baby.
- Planning a vacation or stuck with a hectic schedule? Don’t worry! Our experienced pet sitters and dog walkers will look after your pet as their own.
NUTRITION REPORTS and CUSTOM RECIPES:
- Get tailored nutrition reports and custom recipes crafted by our advanced AI to match your pet's unique dietary needs. Instantly generate balanced meal plans based on their age, weight, breed, and health goals to keep them thriving.
PET REPORT CARDS:

bluejetty:00122968:ios.description:
Moneycontrol App is Asia's #1 App for Business & Finance - Track markets, get loans, do financial transactions, and more.
Track the latest updates on Indian and Global financial markets on your smartphone with the Moneycontrol App. It covers multiple assets from BSE, NSE, MCX and NCDEX exchanges, so you can track Indices (Sensex & Nifty), Stocks, Futures, Options, Mutual Funds, Commodities and Currencies with ease. Additionally, the app facilitates personal loans and fixed deposits.
Monitor your investments with Portfolio and Watchlist. Stay updated with the wide range of news covered in our News and Personal Finance sections. Get expert’s views, in-depth coverage and analysis of the financial markets with live streaming of CNBC AWAAZ (Hindi), CNBC BAJAR (Gujarati) and CNBC PRIME HD.
Here’s what you can expect from the Moneycontrol App.
Seamless Navigation:
• Effortlessly browse your portfolio, markets data, latest news, watchlist, forum, and more.
Latest Market Data:
• Latest quotes and in-depth market stats of stocks, F&O, mutual funds, commodities and currencies from BSE, NSE, MCX and NCDEX
• Latest prices of Sensex, NIFTY, India VIX and more
• Interactive and historical charts such as Line, Area, Candlestick and OHLC 
News:
• Stay informed with the latest market, business, and economy news.
• Enjoy exclusive interviews with top business leaders.
• Use the ‘Text to Speech’ feature to listen to news and articles on the go.
Portfolio:
• Easily monitor your portfolio across stocks, mutual funds, and other assets.
Personalized Watchlist:
• Track your favourite stocks, mutual funds, commodities, futures effortlessly.
Forum Message Board:
• Engage with your favorite topics and follow top boarders for insights.
Moneycontrol Pro Offers:
‣ Ad-free Experience
‣ Personalized News for your portfolio
‣ Insights, Analysis, and Trends with sharp commentary to help make better investment decisions
‣ Ideas for Profit from our in-house and independent research team
‣ Technical Analysis by professional chartists
‣ Smart Calendar of business and economic events
‣ Guru Speak - lessons from successful investors
Moneycontrol Pro subscriptions packages are available on monthly, quarterly and annual basis:
• Monthly - INR 99 per Month (within India) or $1.40 (outside India)
• Quarterly - INR 289 for 3 Months (within India) or $4.09 (outside India)
• Annual - INR 999 for 1 year (within India) or $14.13 (outside India) 
• Payment will be charged to Apple Account at confirmation of purchase and automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
We are excited to announce that Moneycontrol is offering Fixed Deposits.
To Create FD user must follow steps
• Tap on Fixed Deposits
• Sim Binding Process by sending tokenized SMS
• Select your preferred FD
• Complete KYC
• Complete your FD payments via UPI or Net banking.
Need to know more about loan structure? we have covered with below important pointers:
• Loan Tenure : 6 to 60 months
• Max Annual Percentage Rate (APR) : 36%
• Sample loan breakdown :
Loan Amount : Rs 1,00,000/-, Tenure: 3 years, Rate of Interest : 15 %
Principal : 1,00,000
Interest on the loan : 24,795
Monthly Payment for 36 months : 3,467
Processing fees : Approx. 2,000
Please note : Moneycontrol is not directly engaged in money lending activities. We only provide a platform to facilitate money lending by registered Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) or banks to users.
For any queries or feedback regarding the App, you can write to us through the in-App Support section.
https://www.nw18.com/moneycontrol-app-terms

bluejetty:00088639:ios.description:
Pedoro is a simple, easy-to-use step counter that automatically records your steps, walking distance, and calories burned - just by carrying your phone.
No complicated setup. Open the app and see today's steps at a glance. When you reach your daily goal, the screen changes color with a cheerful celebration of stars and confetti. Pedoro makes it fun to take those extra steps every day.
Great for
- Easily tracking your daily steps
- Keeping up a walking habit
- Staying motivated for health and fitness
- Anyone looking for a simple, clear step counter
Features
- Automatic tracking of steps, distance, and calories
- Set a daily step goal and see your achievement rate
- A celebration when you reach your goal
- Review your steps by day, week, and month with graphs
- See achieved days at a glance on the calendar
- Manually add steps for times you didn't carry your phone
- Color themes to match your style (3 free)
- Apple Health integration
Premium (even more convenient)
All core features are free. Choose from 3 free color themes, or all 9 with Premium. A Premium plan also unlocks:
- CSV export of your step data
- Achievement streaks & detailed stats
- Per-weekday step goals
Keep it simple, and enjoy recording every step of your day.
FAQ
Q: Is it free to use?
A: Yes, all core features are free.
Q: Does it work offline?
A: Yes, you can track steps and distance offline.
Q: Does it sync with Apple Health?
A: Yes, it integrates with Apple Health to manage your step data.

bluejetty:00026797:ios.name: Logic Pro: Make Music
bluejetty:00026797:ios.summary: Logic Pro is now part of Apple Creator Studio, an amazing collection of Apple’s most powerful creative apps designed to help you bring your ideas to life. The suite includes Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, Pixelmator Pro, Motion, Compressor, and
bluejetty:00026797:ios.description:
Logic Pro is now part of Apple Creator Studio, an amazing collection of Apple’s most powerful creative apps designed to help you bring your ideas to life. The suite includes Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, Pixelmator Pro, Motion, Compressor, and MainStage — plus premium content and intelligence features in Keynote, Pages, Numbers, and Freeform, all in one simple plan.
Logic Pro for iPad is a professional music creation app that puts the power of the studio right at your fingertips. Tap into a complete collection of sophisticated creative tools for songwriting, beat making, editing, and mixing — all with an interface that’s been designed from the ground up for iPad. Use Multi-Touch to play powerful software instruments with the tap of a finger and interact naturally with intuitive controls. Creative plug-ins like Beat Breaker and Sample Alchemy make it easy to cook up beats and explore new sonic territories. Then access a full featured mixer and Mastering Assistant to give you everything you need to create a professional-sounding mix entirely on iPad.
Creative Interface Optimized for iPad
• Play powerful software instruments and interact expressively using Multi-Touch
• Navigate large complex projects with pinch-to-zoom and swipe-to-scroll
• Discover powerful features and strengthen your skills with integrated guided Lessons
• Create precision edits and detailed track automation with Apple Pencil
• Drag and drop multiple files at once from the Files app to quickly build drum kits or add stems to a project
• Use Stem Splitter to separate nearly any mixed audio recording into six distinct parts: Drums, Bass, Vocals, Guitar, Piano, and Other instruments*
Sound Browser
• Easily discover inspiring sounds with a predictive filtering system
• Use the Sound Library to access an expanding collection of free sound packs
• Access your personal collection of samples directly from Logic’s built-in sound Browser
Professional Instrument and Effects Plug-ins
• Create music with a massive collection of powerful software instruments
• Shape your sound using high-quality effects like vintage EQs and compressors, high-end reverbs, and creative multi-effects
• Build your own guitar or bass rig with Amp Designer and Bass Amp Designer
• Expand your instrument and effects library with third-party Audio Units from the App Store
• Connect an audio interface or MIDI device to record instruments or microphones and control plug-ins and automatable parameters in Logic**
Beat Production
• Radically reshape and reshuffle audio with Beat Breaker, a sophisticated time and pitch morphing instrument 
• Use Sample Alchemy to transform audio into entirely new malleable sounds
• Chop or loop any sample into a playable instrument using Quick Sampler
• Build and play custom drum kits using samples and plug-ins with Drum Machine Designer
• Create drum beats, bass lines, and melodic parts, and reshape sounds over time using Step Sequencer
• Use Live Loops to capture inspiration and quickly build arrangements by mixing and matching loops, samples, and your recordings
AI Session Players
• Discover six professional instrumentalists designed to create nuanced performances, responsive to your direction
• Synth Player, Bass Player, Keyboard Player, Acoustic Drummer, Electronic Drummer, and Percussionist offer a wide range of genres and distinct playing styles
Full-Featured Pro Mixer
• Shape a mix using channel strips with volume faders, pan controls, plug-ins, sends, and precision automation
• Deliver a release-ready mix using Mastering Assistant
Massive Library of Sounds
• Build kits and sampler instruments with over 6,300 samples of drums, vocals, sound effects, and more
• Over 5,700 instrument and effects patches
• More than 12,900 loops in a wide range of styles
* Requires Apple A17 Pro chip or later
** Logic Pro for iPad supports class-compliant audio interfaces or MIDI devices

bluejetty:00170782:ios.description:
Out exploring on your snowmobile? Take your own mobile trail assistant for the ride!
**NEW THIS SEASON**
► Track your trips: leave breadcrumbs for easier backtracking, get statistics on your average speed and distance traveled, and much more!
► List your equipment: keep track of how much distance you covered with a specific vehicle and keep notes on each one.
► Satellite View: enjoy the mobile app with a better basemap and add the Satellite View in your tools!
*****
The New York State Snowmobile Association(NYSSA) brings an enhanced version of its web application to your pockets, making for a better riding experience than ever. Working both with and WITHOUT mobile data coverage, you will be able to enjoy the app’s functionalities no matter where you are on the trails.
This app gives you access to the following *OFFLINE* features, anywhere, anytime, even in areas without cell coverage:
► See your location on the map through your phone’s GPS signal
► View nearby restaurants, gas stations, hotels, parking, and other services
► Access the trail conditions as per the last data connection available
► See the distance between you and a specific point
► Quickly save and load itineraries
Getting back to a zone with mobile coverage? Enjoy these additional *ONLINE* features :
► Keep an eye on updated trail statuses for the best riding experience
► Easily meet with friends by sharing your position with each other (no one else can see your location)
► Plan out an itinerary and share it with your group
Welcome to the NYSSA mobile experience and enjoy the ride!
Notes:
►Continued use of the GPS and location sharing running in the background can significantly increase battery consumption. It is recommended to toggle it off when not needed to improve autonomy.
The Pro Version is a 4.99$ USD per year auto-renewable subscription. Payment will be charged to the iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s account settings after purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and identify the renewal cost. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Link to our privacy policy: https://www.evtrails.com/privacy-terms-and-conditions/
Link to our terms of use: https://www.evtrails.com/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00095332:ios.description:
Who’s a good boy?
Here he is!
Meet Archie, an adorable dog who has just found a new home. It's up to you to help take care of him. In this casual game, you'll form a bond with the dog, interact with his family, and take on fun challenges to keep him happy and healthy. Complete tasks to give Archie everything he needs, help rebuild his new home, and unlock new episodes from his family’s life. No third-party advertising.
Key Game Features
- Casual dog care simulator 
- Engaging mini-games
- Heartwarming story
- Customization options
Sweet Home for a Sweet Dog
Archie is ready to show you around his new home! There’s a cozy bedroom where Archie can take a nap, a kitchen where you can prepare meals and feed him, and a bathroom where you can keep him squeaky clean. Make his home the perfect place for Archie and his family with decorating activities and building projects. Don’t forget to visit the wardrobe and customize Archie’s look. Dress him in cute outfits, change his fur and eye color, and choose new accessories to make him even more adorable! 
Episode by Episode
Besides caring for your little friend, you’ll get to know his family and follow their heartwarming story. Each episode reveals more about their lives, and you’ll become a part of their story! The episodes introduce charming cartoon-style characters you'll enjoy getting to know. Don’t miss a single moment of Archie’s life!
Fun Mini-Games for Everyone 
Here, you’ll play mini-games to take care of Archie and meet his needs. Each time you complete a task or solve a puzzle, you’ll earn points and rewards to help keep him happy and healthy. Everything your furry friend needs is unlocked through fun challenges. Keep him happy by completing daily quests and earning medals and points to unlock special gifts.
Ready to begin your tail-wagging adventure? 
Archie and his new family are waiting for you! With engaging puzzles, heartwarming stories, and fun customization options, every day brings a new adventure. Take care of your fluffy friend, unlock special rewards, and enjoy a relaxing journey as you form an unbreakable bond with your virtual pet.
SUBSCRIPTION
Enjoy the game and get bonuses:
1. More clothes for your dog
2. 3 extra lives in mini-games 
3. 1000 Coins every day
4. 1000 Bucks every day
Premium subscription details:
- Start with a free three-day trial. When the trial ends, a paid weekly subscription will begin automatically.
- Subscriptions are available in weekly, monthly, and annual plans.
- A weekly subscription costs $9.99, a monthly subscription costs $19.99, and an annual subscription costs $49.99.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel your subscription or end your free trial at any time. To avoid being charged or to prevent renewal, cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial or current subscription period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
- Read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://brainytrainee.com/privacy.html
https://brainytrainee.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00128816:ios.description:
Neverwinter Nights is a classic Dungeons & Dragons RPG— enhanced for iOS! Explore 100+ hours of gameplay including the original campaign, plus six free DLC adventures. Play solo or team up with friends for a grand adventure across the Forgotten Realms.
DEVICE RECOMMENDATION
Optimized for iPads
Recommended for iPhones with screen sizes of 6 inches or larger 
CONTENT
Neverwinter Nights (Classic Campaign)
Shadows of Undrentide (Free DLC)
Hordes of the Underdark (Free DLC)
Kingmaker (Free DLC)
ShadowGuard (Free DLC)
Witch’s Wake (Free DLC)
Adventure Pack (Free DLC)
FEATURES
Re-engineered UI for iPads and iPhones
- Virtual joystick and context sensitive button makes gameplay easy
- UI Scales automatically or can be set to your liking
Cross-Platform Multiplayer
- Adventure with friends!
- Cross-play support includes compatibility with mobile, tablets, computers and consoles 
- Join persistent worlds, with community-run campaigns and up to 250 players
Improved Graphics
- Pixel shaders and post-processing effects make for cleaner graphics and visuals
- Adjustable contrast, vibrance, and depth of field options
STORY CONTENT: 
Neverwinter Nights (Original Campaign)
You find yourself at the center of intrigue, betrayal, and dark magic in Neverwinter Nights. Journey through dangerous cities, monster filled dungeons and deep into uncharted wilderness in search of the cure for a cursed plague ravaging the city of Neverwinter.
Shadows of Undrentide (Free DLC Expansion) 
Another adventure begins in the updated expansion, Shadows of Undrentide! Charged by your master to recover four ancient artifacts, travel from the Silver Marches to unravel mysteries of a long-dead magical civilization.
Hordes of the Underdark (Free DLC Expansion)
This expansion continues the adventure started in Shadows of Undrentide. Journey into the ever-more bizarre and hostile depths of Undermountain to challenge a gathering evil.
Three Premium Modules (Free DLC)
Discover over 40 hours of new Dungeons & Dragons adventures across the Forgotten Realms in these premium modules for Neverwinter Nights: 
- Kingmaker
- ShadowGuard
- Witch’s Wake
- Adventure Pack
LANGUAGES
- English

bluejetty:00071061:ios.description:
Malayalam, your way.
Manglish helps you write Malayalam using familiar English letters. Type njan and choose ഞാൻ. Use the Manglish keyboard in your favourite apps, or write and save notes inside Manglish.
TYPE IN MALAYALAM
• Malayalam transliteration with word suggestions.
• Switch between Malayalam and English.
• Customise your keyboard settings.
• Ordinary typing works without Full Access.
SPEAK IN MALAYALAM
• Turn your speech into text using an on-device model.
• Set up voice in Manglish, then use keyboard voice controls while your microphone session is active.
• Review the result and tap Insert when you are ready.
• Optional noise reduction is available in voice settings.
• The speech model needs an initial download; recognition runs on your device.
MORE WAYS TO EXPRESS YOURSELF
• Malayalam handwriting, after initial model setup.
• Stickers and custom images.
• Notes you can save, copy and share.
• A typing guide with Malayalam examples.
• Dictionary lookup powered by OLAM.
മലയാളം എഴുതാൻ ഇനി എളുപ്പം.
ഇംഗ്ലീഷ് അക്ഷരങ്ങളിൽ ടൈപ്പ് ചെയ്യൂ, മലയാളത്തിൽ എഴുതൂ.
സംസാരിച്ചും കൈയെഴുത്തിലൂടെയും മലയാളം എഴുതാം.
GET STARTED
Add Manglish in Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards. Select it using the globe key. Full Access is needed for shared voice commands and certain optional keyboard features. Microphone access is requested in the Manglish app.
VOICE AND PREMIUM
Free voice typing includes a daily allowance, with rewarded top-ups when available. Premium removes ads and the daily voice quota. Available prices, periods and subscription terms are shown before purchase.
PRIVACY
Typed text and microphone audio stay on your device for transliteration and speech recognition. Dictionary lookups send the word you choose to OLAM. Ads, purchases and diagnostics use their respective services. See the privacy policy for details.

bluejetty:00166423:android.description:
Welcome to Nickelodeon Card Clash, the ultimate collectible card game that’s about to become your new obsession! Get ready to flex on your friends with epic card battles featuring your favorite Nickelodeon characters from SpongeBob SquarePants, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (TMNT), and Avatar: The Last Airbender.
Collect Iconic Characters: Dive into the nostalgia and collect cards of iconic characters like SpongeBob, Patrick, Leonardo, Aang, and so many more! Whether you’re a meme lord or just love these legendary toons, there’s a card for everyone. Build your deck with rare and legendary cards to become the envy of all your friends.
Strategize and Battle: Challenge players from around the world and show off your strategic genius. Whether you’re a big-brain tactician or just winging it, there’s a place for you on the leaderboards. Outplay your opponents, rise to the top, and earn bragging rights as the ultimate Nick card master.
Exciting Events and Updates: Say goodbye to boredom with regular updates and lit events. Participate in limited-time challenges to earn exclusive rewards and unlock new cards. With constant new content, there’s always something fresh and exciting to look forward to. Stay ahead of the game and keep your deck unbeatable.
Stunning Visuals and Animations: Feast your eyes on stunning card art and animations that bring your favorite characters to life. These aren’t just cards – they’re mini works of art! Each character is designed with so much detail, you’ll want to collect them all just to admire the visuals.
Comprehensive Tutorials and Guides: New to the game? No worries! Our easy-to-follow tutorials will have you battling like a pro in no time. Learn the ropes, master advanced strategies, and soon you'll be crushing opponents left and right. Whether you’re a newbie or a seasoned player, there’s always something new to learn.
Customizable Decks and Play Styles: Your deck, your rules. Customize your deck to match your play style, whether you’re all about offensive moves, defensive tactics, or a balanced approach. Mix and match characters and abilities to create the ultimate winning combination. Experiment and find the perfect deck that suits your vibe.
Regular Rewards and Incentives: Get rewarded just for playing! Log in daily to score bonuses, complete quests, and tackle challenges to earn epic rewards. Collect new cards, earn in-game currency, and power up your deck. The more you play, the more you gain, making every session worth your time.
Download Nickelodeon Card Clash today and dive into the most epic card-battling adventure ever! Whether you’re here for the nostalgia, the strategy, or just to chill with your favorite characters, you’re in for a wild ride. Let the clash begin and may the best deck win!

Transparent App Icons is the easiest, simplest way to customize your iOS 14+ Home Screen with icons that are set against the background wallpaper to look like they’re transparent. - Automatically crop uploaded images to your phone’s wallpaper size
- Quickly create icon images for entire home screen pages
- Overlay transparent images to create a see-through logo effect: 2200+ logos and symbols included in the app
- Transparent App Icons is a one time purchase, paid up front: no subscriptions, no selling data, no need to log in
- Absolutely never, ever, ever any ads
There’s no corporation trying to extract ad dollars here - I’m just one developer, and I hope Transparent App Icons can help you create creative and aesthetic iOS 14 home screen layouts! If you have any questions, feel free to reach out at support@transparenticons.app, or on Twitter at @TransparentIcns - thank you!

Always stay up to date with the latest local news, national, sports, traffic, political, entertainment stories and much more. Download the KCCI 8 News app for free today.

- Des Moines breaking news alerts with push notifications
- Live streaming breaking news updates from our KCCI 8 News reporters when it happens, where it happens

- An interactive radar that lets you zoom in and out to street level and watch storms as they approach. Move the map around to see major weather activity

Although Hearst Television believes the majority of its news content is appropriate for a variety of ages, it is intended for individuals 18 and older.

bluejetty:00200039:ios.summary: If you’re interested in movies (or filmmaking) and have been looking for a way to waste several hours, we have the app for you! 02074 is the ultimate creative love story; you’ll learn (in excruciating detail) how the movie JAWS activated a
bluejetty:00200039:ios.description:
If you’re interested in movies (or filmmaking) and have been looking for a way to waste several hours, we have the app for you! 02074 is the ultimate creative love story; you’ll learn (in excruciating detail) how the movie JAWS activated a young Steven Soderbergh and set him on a lifelong path of discovery, passion, and the relentless pursuit of unified acclaim and unjustified compensation. You’ll see, in granular detail, how Steven Spielberg battled the forces of Nature and technology day after day to fashion his landscape-altering masterpiece, followed by an insanely subjective twenty-five thousand word analysis by Soderbergh of the finished film. Not content to leave it at that, Soderbergh concludes this exercise by spewing everything he’s learned to date about the job of directing, complete with tips, workarounds, and real-world anecdotes bold and provocative enough to shock even the most jaded professional. The entire experience is brought to a uniquely insightful conclusion with an epilogue by Steven Spielberg himself.
Whatever your ultimate response, you can sleep well at night knowing that ONE HUNDRED PERCENT of the proceeds for this app go to charity—making it the only JAWS-associated product to never turn a profit. 
And we’re not going to get into a whole privacy policy thing because we won’t be in touch and we won’t be using your information for anything, ever. You’ll never hear from us again (unless there’s an update? But don’t know why there would be. We’re DONE).

Your Home Warranty Protection, Simplified:
The Choice Home Warranty app puts complete control of your home warranty coverage right in your hands. Manage claims, track service requests, and access your account anytime, anywhere—all from one convenient mobile platform.
File Claims Quickly & Easily:
When a covered appliance or system breaks down, you need help fast. Submit new service requests in just minutes directly from your phone. Simply select the item that needs repair, describe the issue, and submit—no phone calls or paperwork required.
Track Your Claims in Real-Time:
Stay informed every step of the way. View all your active and past claims, check current status updates, and see when technicians are scheduled to arrive. Know exactly where your claim stands at any moment.

bluejetty:00031781:ios.description:
*NOTICE* Play the beginning for free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks the full game. No ads.
In this kingdom management RPG, petitioners will arrive in the throne room each turn to ask for your advice and assistance. Decide whether to help them with their problems, or to conserve resources for more important matters. Remember: supplies are limited, and not everyone has the kingdom’s best interests at heart...
Yes, Your Grace tells a tale of Davern, a medieval kingdom ruled by King Eryk. The game is set in a fictional world where monsters and arcane practices inspired by Slavic folklore are the order of the day. Villagers will ask for your help with various problems, from monsters attacking the village to a lack of places to relax and enjoy themselves. Some will bring humour to your throne room and some will present you with difficult choices. Your family is important too, and throughout your time as King, you will have to support them in their struggles.
You will face lords with a variety of personalities; you will need their support in order to win an upcoming battle, but some may ask you to perform dirty deeds to cement the alliance. One thing is clear: It won’t be easy to keep everyone happy...
Listen to petitioners each turn and decide who needs your support.
Aid your family with their personal problems and decide upon their fate.
Hire Generals, Witches and Hunters to aid your efforts.
Prepare for battle and make alliances by satisfying the whims of lords and kings.
Follow the stories of the quirky and determined characters that visit your halls.

bluejetty:00027131:ios.description:
Dungeon Hunter is BACK!
Thrilling Gameloft ARPG Sequel!
Unite, fearless Bounty Hunters, and embrace Dungeon Hunter VI - a unique and enthralling hack-and-slash odyssey that continues the cherished Dungeon Hunter saga. As a seasoned dungeon crawler, enter uncharted dungeon territories, reunite with iconic Dungeon Hunter characters, and experience a new level of excitement in this extraordinary action-packed MMORPG installment!
Return to Valenthia's dungeons 200 years after the brave sacrifice of the Dungeon Hunter and experience brand new thrilling Dungeon quests, in a scale never seen before in a Dungeon Hunter game. The Hunter's legacy is interwoven with action, as dungeons beckon with the promise of untold loot and hack-and-slash glory.
Join the Heroes' journey as they try to stop the malevolent powers that emerged from the Forbidden Towers, and combat hordes of Demons in an EPIC dungeon crawl for loot, hack-and-slash mastery in Dungeon Hunter VI. This action MMORPG sets new standards for action games!
Pick one of the 7 available Dungeon Hunter classes, summon your most trusted Companions and dive into Dungeons as you save the realm from new and returning evils in Dungeon Hunter VI. The Hunter's path is strewn with action, hack-and-slash challenges, and loot beyond imagination.
Wealth, Respect, Glory, Power… all await in Dungeon Hunter VI!
Game Highlights:
1. Immerse Yourself in New Action-Packed Adventures
- Embark on an epic new Dungeon Hunter Campaign, solve the mysteries of the Forbidden Towers and save the Realm from the Demons.
- Explore Valenthia like never before in Dungeon Hunter VI and experience new unique dungeons brimming with action and loot.
2. Forge Your Own Dungeon Hunter's Journey
- Choose from the iconic Dungeon Hunter classes: Warrior, Assassin, Archer, Mage, Boon Sister, Shaman and Bloodthirsty Knight；
In Dungeon Hunter VI, gear up and customize your Heroes, piece by piece, for epic hack-and-slash battles!
- Customize your Dungeon Hunter skill trees suited to how you play!
3. Rally Your Dungeon Forces and Forge New Bonds
- In Dungeon Hunter VI, gather and summon powerful Lieutenants that range from Monsters to Legendary Heroes of the Past!
- Join or create Dungeon Hunter Guilds and collaborate with allies to loot and defeat formidable foes that threaten your world!
4. Premium Quality Gaming Experience of Dungeon Hunter VI
- Stunningly upgraded visuals in Dungeon Hunter VI bring the world alive with vivid locations, well-designed characters, and dynamic hack-and-slash combat effects.
- Find yourself immersed in a captivating Dungeon Hunter narrative, brought to life by professional voice acting and compelling sound tracks designed for loot hunters and action lovers.
Prepare to delve deeper into the heart of action with Dungeon Hunter VI, where every hack and slash, every piece of loot, and every dungeon adventure cements your legacy as the ultimate hunter in this MMORPG world. The dungeons await, Hunter—are you ready to claim your destiny and become a legend in the exhilarating world of Dungeon Hunter VI?

bluejetty:00039759:ios.description:
O Devocionário é uma ferramenta digital projetada para enriquecer sua vida espiritual e fortalecer sua fé católica. Este aplicativo oferece uma variedade de recursos para ajudá-lo a se conectar com Deus e com a comunidade católica, não importa onde você esteja. Com o Devocionário, você pode acessar homilias inspiradoras, acompanhar a liturgia das horas, e ler as leituras diárias da missa para manter-se alinhado com o calendário litúrgico da Igreja.
Para aqueles que buscam um guia na oração, o Devocionário fornece assistência interativa para a oração do Rosário, incluindo reflexões sobre os mistérios e gravações de áudio para facilitar a meditação. Além disso, o aplicativo contém uma vasta biblioteca de cantos gregorianos e música sacra, proporcionando um ambiente propício para a oração e a contemplação.
O Devocionário também traz conteúdo de alguns dos mais influentes sacerdotes e teólogos da atualidade, como Padre Paulo Ricardo e Padre José Eduardo, além de materiais do Instituto do Verbo Encarnado. Com atualizações frequentes, o aplicativo se mantém atualizado conforme calendário litúrgico.
Este aplicativo é o companheiro perfeito para quem deseja crescer na fé e viver a espiritualidade católica de forma mais plena. Baixe o Devocionário e leve sua fé sempre com você, transformando cada momento em uma oportunidade de conexão com Nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
Viva a Igreja Católica! Viva Cristo Rei e Salve Maria Santíssima! +++

bluejetty:00173139:ios.name: Mideo: Record Video With Music
bluejetty:00173139:ios.summary:
Join the thousands of Mideo users who already are using Mideo to record videos with music! Mideo is the must-have app for anyone who wants to listen to music and record video at the same time.
How it works:
Play music through any app, then
bluejetty:00173139:ios.description:
Join the thousands of Mideo users who already are using Mideo to record videos with music! Mideo is the must-have app for anyone who wants to listen to music and record video at the same time.
How it works:
Play music through any app, then open Mideo and start recording. The music won't pause, and you can record while it plays. You can easily use Control Center on your device to change the song that's playing while you record.
Mideo uses your device’s built-in high-quality video camera and instantly saves the videos you take straight to the Photos app.
—
Additional features:
• Supports front, back, portrait, landscape, flash, zoom, tap to focus, and grid lines. Just like the built-in camera app.
• Options to record video in 720p, 1080p, or 4K resolutions. (4K is available on supported devices only.)
• Displays how much video you can record based on your remaining device storage.
• An option to start recording whenever you open the app. No need to tap the record button!
• Easily access your Camera Roll with the press of a button.
—
Still not sure if Mideo fits your use case? Email us at hello@topanga.tech and we will point you in the right direction. Also be sure to check out mideo.app/support for our comprehensive FAQ website. You can use Mideo for all kinds of things, whether you're a dancer, weightlifter, drummer, singer, or anything else.
Without Mideo, your music will stop whenever you open the built-in video camera. Mideo is the media monster of video recording apps, since with Mideo can you video muse from any audio source without any interruptions. Relish and record, listen, shine with Mideo today.
—
How to take videos without pausing background music:
1. Play audio from any source (Apple Music, Spotify, Podcasts, SoundCloud, etc.) 
2. Pause the music if you want, or keep it playing - it doesn't matter. 
3. Open the Mideo app and start recording. (Notice how your music doesn't pause! If it does, resume the music using your headphones or with Control Center.) 
4. While recording in Mideo, you can use Control Center to restart, resume, or change the song.
—
To record videos WITH the background music in the video, play audio to a speaker. (your device’s built-in speaker or an external speaker) 
To record videos WITHOUT the background music in the video, play audio to headphones.

bluejetty:00089628:ios.description:
Stay on top of your stocks — without the noise.
Pick your stocks. See what happened to them, biggest story first, in plain English. Catch up in minutes. No sign-up. No ads.
"I ONLY HAVE FIVE MINUTES"
• Your Catch-Up — the top stories for your stocks since your last catch-up. Read it, and you're up to date.
• Evening Brief (The Day in Markets) — the whole market in one recap, every weekday after the US market closes. Tap the bell for a reminder at a time you choose.
"WHAT HAPPENED TO MY STOCK?"
• Today at a Glance — open any stock: today's biggest story, if there's more news than usual, and if the news leans good or bad.
• The Story So Far — just added a stock? Its key stories of the past three months, oldest first.
"WHAT IS EVERYONE TALKING ABOUT?"
• Top Stories — the biggest stories right now, with related news in one place.
• Trending — the stocks mentioned most in the news, with "why it's trending" in plain English for the day's top 3.
"I DON'T UNDERSTAND WHAT THIS MEANS"
• AI Summary — the key points of a story in a few lines, written privately on your device.
• Checked against the article — numbers and big claims, like a lawsuit or a takeover. If one doesn't hold up, it's rewritten or cut, or you see the article's own words. AI can still make mistakes, so check key details.
• Tap to Explain — in the Evening Brief, Your Catch-Up and Today at a Glance, tap an underlined word like "hawkish" for a simple meaning.
"MY HANDS ARE BUSY"
• Listen — hear the Evening Brief or Your Catch-Up in full, or the first lines of an article, while you cook, drive or walk. Keeps playing with the screen locked.
"I HEARD A RUMOR"
• Type the company and what you heard into Search. See whether major news outlets mention it in the past month, or only the company's own press releases do. Then read what they say. Works for the whole market too.
"JUST THE STOCKS I CARE ABOUT"
• Watchlists — as many as you like, up to 50 stocks each, from 22,000+ stocks and ETFs.
• 24 Topics — like Artificial Intelligence, Electric Vehicles, Big Tech, Earnings and Dividends.
• Fewer repeats — the same story from many sites usually shows once in your news.
• Save articles for later. Your lists and saved articles sync with iCloud.
WHAT'S FREE
• Every headline, plus Watchlists, Trending, Topics, Search and Listen.
• The Evening Brief, Your Catch-Up, Today at a Glance and The Story So Far.
• 5 articles a day. Reopening one that day is free.
• AI summaries and "why it's trending" — free for 7 days from your first one. No purchase needed. The AI summary in the Evening Brief stays free after that.
STOCKS NEWS PREMIUM
• Open as many articles as you like — no daily limit.
• Keep AI summaries and "why it's trending" after those 7 days.
• Read the whole Top Stories summary, not just two lines.
A lock marks stories where the news site may ask you to subscribe, even with Premium.
WILL THE AI WORK ON MY IPHONE OR IPAD?
The AI features run on your device with Apple Intelligence. You need:
• an iPhone or iPad that supports Apple Intelligence
• iOS or iPadOS 26 or later
• Apple Intelligence turned on in Settings and fully downloaded
Everything else works without it, including Listen and the full Top Stories summary (Premium).
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
• Name: Stocks News Premium (Monthly)
• Length: 1 month
• Price: $9.99 (US) per month. New subscribers get a 3-day free trial of Premium first.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase, or when the 3-day free trial ends. It renews automatically, and you're charged within 24 hours before each period ends, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before. Any unused part of the 3-day free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Stocks News reports market news. It does not give investment advice.
Privacy Policy
https://fierce-inlet-63133.herokuapp.com/stocks-news-privacy
Terms of Use
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

——————————————————————————————————————————
Use Grifols DonorHub™ to:
• Check your donation and compensation history
bluejetty:00175408:ios.description:
Your Plasma Donation experience just got smoother! Grifols DonorHubTM is your go-to place for all your plasma donor needs. 
——————————————————————————————————————————
Use Grifols DonorHub™ to:
• Check your donation and compensation history - Details of your most recent donation are available in Grifols DonorHub™ 24 hours after your visit. 
• Stay up-to-date on all things Grifols Plasma- Enable push notifications to never miss an update. 
• Receive tips to help prepare for your next plasma donation. 
• Learn what happens to your plasma after your donation. 
• Schedule your donation appointments.
• Refer a Friend: Spread the Word & Earn Rewards: Easily refer friends and family to become plasma donors.
• Ask the Chatbot any question you have
——————————————————————————————————————————
Tips for a Better Donation Experience
7. Drink at least 12-to-24 ounces of water or a sports drink 30-to-60 minutes before your donation. Proper hydration helps ensure the procedure is well-tolerated and recovery is quicker.
8. Limit caffeinated beverages and milk on the day of your donation, as they reduce iron absorption and can elevate your pulse.
9. Avoid alcohol the day before and the day of your donation to prevent dehydration.
10. Avoid foods high in saturated fats and cholesterol the night before your donation, as they can make the donation process longer.
11. Get a good night’s rest before your donation to aid in quicker recovery.
12. Discontinue and avoid all tobacco products before donating, as they may increase your blood pressure and heart rate.
——————————————————————————————————————————
Getting started is easy:
If you're already registered in Grifols DonorHub™:
Just download the app and log in! The Grifols DonorHub™ app has all the features found in the web version. If you're not registered yet:
Download the Grifols DonorHub™ app.
Register for Grifols DonorHub™: Enter your registration number, name, date of birth, mobile phone number, email address, and choose a password.
Don’t forget to turn on notifications for Grifols DonorHub™!

bluejetty:00146412:ios.description:
Discover and bookmark the best of Shanghai.
SmartShanghai is Shanghai’s longest-running online English-language city guide. For over 20 years, our editors on the ground have been discovering, reviewing and curating the places, events and things worth knowing about.
From restaurants and bars to exhibitions, concerts, family activities and hidden neighborhood spots, we help you find the best of Shanghai — and save the things you want to come back to.
Discover
Browse our hand-picked selection of restaurants, bars, cafés, shops and other places around Shanghai.
Save Your Favorites
Bookmark places, events and articles you want to come back to and build your own Shanghai list.
What’s On
Find things happening around the city, from live music and nightlife to exhibitions, markets, dining events and family activities.
Editorial
Guides, recommendations and stories from our Shanghai-based editorial team, covering the city for more than 20 years.
Housing
Browse apartments for rent across Shanghai, with thousands of current listings from local agencies and landlords.
Tickets
Discover upcoming shows and events and buy tickets directly through SmartShanghai.
Essential Shanghai
Practical information for living in and visiting Shanghai, including useful services and emergency information.
Whether you’ve just arrived, are visiting for a few days, or have lived here for years, SmartShanghai helps you discover more of Shanghai — and keep track of the places you don’t want to forget.

Grade Corner is the fastest way for students and parents to check grades, schedules, assignments, and attendance as part of your daily routine without logging in every time.
Compatible with Aspen, Infinite Campus (beta), and PowerSchool (b
bluejetty:00186609:ios.description:
Grade Corner is the fastest way for students and parents to check grades, schedules, assignments, and attendance as part of your daily routine without logging in every time.
Compatible with Aspen, Infinite Campus (beta), and PowerSchool (beta).
This app is an independent tool students may use to calculate and track their own grades.
=== GRADE CORNER PREMIUM
We are committed to providing every student full access to their grades without advertisements. We offer the following additional functionality to support the ongoing development of the app:
- Grade Calculator — see your true percentage including missing assignments
 - Add hypothetical future assignments to see how they'd affect your grade
 - Edit current assignments to plan makeup work
Important: The Grade Calculator is for estimation only and does not guarantee your final score.
=== PRIVACY & ENDORSEMENTS
Grade Corner is a member of the Student Data Privacy Consortium (SDPC) and is available for schools to endorse in Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, and Vermont.
=== SUPPORTED SCHOOL DISTRICTS
- School districts using Aspen Student Information System (SIS)
- School districts using Infinite Campus
- School districts using PowerSchool
Grade Corner is an independent application and is not affiliated with, associated with, authorized by, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Follett School Solutions (Aspen Student Information System), Infinite Campus, Inc., PowerSchool Group LLC, or any school district using those systems, unless explicitly stated.
=== COMMON QUESTIONS
Q: Do I need an existing account with my school's grading system?
A: Yes. Grade Corner is a companion app — it uses your existing gradebook credentials. If you don't know yours, ask your school administrator.
Q: How often are grades updated?
A: As soon as teachers post them. When they update grades in the gradebook, you'll see the changes on your next refresh.
Q: Is this app officially supported by my school district?
A: Sometimes. Grade Corner was built independently by a parent with two kids in DC Public Schools. We're working on more official endorsements — the current list lives on our website.
=== DISCLAIMERS
Grade Corner is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Follett School Solutions (Aspen Student Information System), Infinite Campus, Inc., PowerSchool Group LLC, or any of the school districts listed above, unless otherwise stated.
Aspen is a trademark of Follett School Solutions. Infinite Campus is a trademark of Infinite Campus, Inc. PowerSchool is a trademark of PowerSchool Group LLC. All trademarks are the property of their respective owners.
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00148613:ios.description:

على الجانب الاخر جميع الوحدات المعروضة من خلال تطبيق إيجارات App-Rents تكون متاحة أمام مستخدمى التطبيق وزوار الموقع الالكتروني ويمكن لأي زائر أن يقوم بحجز أي وحدة خلال ثواني معدودة مع إمكانية الدفع عبر البطاقات الائتمانية أو الدفع عند الوصول لبعض الوحدات.
تطبيق إيجارات App-Rents يوفر أدوات بحث متقدمة مع واجهة مستخدم بسيطة وسهلة باللغتين العربية والانجليزية.
تطبيق إيجارات App-Rents مثالي للأفراد والشركات والتطبيق تم تطويره بواسطة فريق المطورين في بلدو دوت كوم ويدار بواسطة موظفي Beldo.com

VIP Belote is a free card game - easy to understand but hard to master! It is a very fast and responsive online card game, with modern animations for realistic gameplay. The complete experience is underlined by HD graphics, stylish design and numerous cool features.
Benefits of VIP Belote
- High quality multiplayer Belote, Coinche and Contrée with Declarations.
- Play with everyone on our cross-platform online card game. Available for WEB, Facebook, all mobile operating systems and Smart TV alike.
- Play in Tournaments and win attractive prizes.
- Create a social or fighting club! Be a leader, invite friends and level the club up!
- Complete 3 daily challenges
- Participate in a “knockout” tournament against all level players.
Key features of the game
- Play Belote, Coinche and Contrée with Declarations (AT/NT) everywhere - meet new people and send them gifts or simply chat with friends.

- Entertaining gameplay and easy to remember rules, yet challenging experience!

- Get free chips every day, win special prizes and earn gifts from other players.

- Clever card game artificial intelligence to replace a disconnected player.
- Penalties when you leave a game to encourage fair play!
- Experience booster which will speed up your progress!

- Moderate topics in the global chat
- Mark your friends as 'close' with the "Close friends" option. Receive a notification when they are online.
- Upload images and send emojis
- Meet new people, easy dating functionality!
- Chat online, have real, in-game conversations with other players during a custom game.

- Get likes from other players!

- Players from all over the world.

VIP Belote continues to evolve! Expect upcoming releases, which will continue to surprise you and improve the quality of the game.

bluejetty:00156928:ios.description:
Our goal is to replace paper and make your Secret Santa and similar games easier, at Christmas and Easter.
REMOTE draw mode:
- Add the names of participants of the secret santa!
- Select restrictions between participants, if necessary.
- Click the share button to send the code to the participant to find out who the secret santa is.
- Do this for all participants and end of draw! :D
IN-PERSON draw mode:
- Add the names of participants of the secret santa!
- Select restrictions between participants, if necessary.
- The app will show you who should view the screen that will present the secret santa!
- Memorize your secret santa, and swipe your smartphone or tablet so that the next nominee can view his or her random secret santa!
- By the time everyone knows the secret santa drawn, the draw is over! : D
In addition to the classic Secret Santa, our app is perfect for many game variations, such as:
- Chocolate Friend: ideal for Easter, where participants exchange chocolates as gifts.
- Joker Friend: funny or unusual gifts to lighten the mood.
- Themed Friend: all gifts follow a specific theme, like books, plants, or handmade items.
- Surprise Friend: the draw happens at the moment of the exchange, making everything more exciting.

bluejetty:00131062:ios.description:
Save money. Live better. 
The Walmart app is the easiest way to shop for everything on your list, including fresh groceries, household essentials, the latest tech and a lot more. Plus, our convenient pickup, delivery and shipping options make it a breeze to get your order exactly when you want it, whether you’re shopping in-store or on the go.
Meet Sparky, your AI assistant:
Sparky makes it easy. Ask Sparky! You’ll get answers fast with real-time Q&A. Get review summaries to help you make the best pick. Hosting a party? Tell Sparky. Get help shopping for birthdays, housewarmings & more.
Convenient ways to get your items: 
Pickup 
Swing by the store to collect your order curbside—we’ll even load your car. 
Delivery 
From a local store straight to your door. For those need-it-now moments, choose Express delivery to get your order in as little as one hour.* 
*Restrictions and fees apply. 
Shipping 
Fast two-day shipping, dropped off by FedEx or UPS. Eligible orders over $35 ship free! 
Even more time-saving features you’ll love: 
Store maps 
Find it faster. Quickly locate your faves with easy-to-use features 
Real-time order tracking 
Get live order updates sent straight to your phone and track order status any time from the homepage. 
Reorder your essentials 
Quickly and easily fill your cart with frequently purchased items. 
Shopping lists 
Create, share and add to lists to prepare for any occasion. 
Walmart Pay 
Use Walmart Pay In-store. Touch-free payments: Use your phone at checkout, no need for cards or cash. Easily access e-receipts to make returns a breeze
Curbside check-in 
Check in with the app when you’re ready to pick up your order and we’ll bring it out to you. 
Scanner 
Check a price, offer availability, reviews & more. 
Pharmacy 
Refill, transfer, manage and pick up your family’s prescriptions. Plus, schedule vaccinations, locate testing sites and more. 
New! Get eligible prescriptions & more delivered as soon as today with no order minimum fees.
Walmart+ members—our app is the easiest way to get the most out of your membership. App-exclusive features for Walmart+ include: 
Scan & go 
Use your phone to shop in-store and check out contact-free. 
Gas Savings
Get up to 10¢ off every gallon at 13,000+ locations nationwide**—including Exxon and Mobil stations! 
**Available at participating stations. May vary by location & subject to change.
EXPRESSAPP Code Terms & Conditions
A credit will be applied to eligible orders with a valid discount code to cover the Express Delivery fee. Offer valid for first time Walmart Express Delivery orders only. Order must be placed in the Walmart app. Minimum order of $50. Offer not transferable and void where prohibited by law. Does not apply to alcohol or Rx purchases. Customer responsible for all applicable taxes. Offer subject to change or expire without notice. Standard item restrictions apply.

bluejetty:00044288:ios.description:
Struggling in your marriage? Tired of the same fights, silent treatments, or feeling like roommates instead of partners? We’ve got the tools to help!
Marriage365 is the first app designed by real couples, for real couples. With expert-led videos, courses, worksheets, challenges, and podcasts, you’ll get practical, experience-based guidance on everything from emotional and physical intimacy to trust, forgiveness, conflict, and even infidelity.
Over 100,000 marriages have used Marriage365 to build the deep connection they’ve always wanted. And the best part? You don’t need your spouse to start making a change.
Begin with the Marriage365 Checkup—a personalized roadmap that pinpoints where to start and what to focus on. Whether you’re in a great place or struggling, you’ll find the right tools to grow.
Download today and take the first step toward a healthier, happier you!
Have questions? Email us at help@marriage365.com.

You can turn off auto-renew in your app store subscription management center. Payment will only be charged to your account at confirmation of purchase and once your free trial period has ended. Please note, deleting the Marriage365 app from your device does not cancel your subscription. You must cancel inside your app store subscription management center.

bluejetty:00061834:ios.summary: یتیح تطبیق الوسیط.نت لمستخدمیه تصفح آلاف الإعلانات المبوبة مجاناً في 12 بلد عربي في الشرق الأوسط و الشمال الأفريقي بسهولة و يسر. حيث یعتبر الوسیط.نت أفضل وأسرع طریقة لبیع وشراء المنتجات الجدیدة و المستعملة كالسیارات والعقارات وسائر الإلكترو
bluejetty:00061834:ios.description:
یتیح تطبیق الوسیط.نت لمستخدمیه تصفح آلاف الإعلانات المبوبة مجاناً في 12 بلد عربي في الشرق الأوسط و الشمال الأفريقي بسهولة و يسر. حيث یعتبر الوسیط.نت أفضل وأسرع طریقة لبیع وشراء المنتجات الجدیدة و المستعملة كالسیارات والعقارات وسائر الإلكترونيات، بالإضافة إلى إمكانية البحث عن وظائف شاغرة والإعلان عنها.
یمكنك عبر الوسیط.نت عرض العدید من المنتجات سواء للبیع أو الإيجار بشكل مجاني و بدون أي عمولة و ذلك من خلال أحد الأقسام التالية:
 قسم السیارات والذي یضم آلاف السیارات والمركبات المعروضة سواء للبیع أو الإيجار.
قسم العقارات والذي یمكنك من الإعلان عن الفلل والشقق والأراضي والمكاتب للبیع أو للإيجار، حيث یسهل علیك البحث عن العقارات في مدینتك ومنطقتك بدون عناء.
قسم إعلانات التوظیف المخصص للإعلان عن الوظائف الشاغرة، وفرص العمل المتاحة في السوق المحلي، كما یمكن الباحثین عن عمل من طلب الوظائف بالإضافة إلى رفع سیرهم الذاتیة على التطبیق مباشرة.
قسم الإعلانات المبوبة ویندرج تحته العدید من المنتجات الأجهزة الالكترونیة و المنزلية، والمفروشات، والساعات والمجوهرات، الملابس والجوالات، ، مستلزمات الاطفال، وغیرها الكثیر من الاغراض المعروضة للبیع أونلاین .
كما تتیح الإعلانات المبوبة الإعلان عن الخدمات و الحرف العديدة، كنقل العفش، و النجارة، والأصباغ، والتنظیف، واستقدام العمالة، الى آخره من سائر الخدمات الضروریة في كافة البلدان.
Operating in 12 different countries in the Gulf and MENA regions, Waseet.net is the focal point for online visitors in the Middle East. 
With just a few clicks away and no commission, Waseet.net allows you to browse daily added listings for both new and secondhand products located in your city through thousands of online ads. You can search for cars, real estate, electronics, home appliances, clothes, perfumes, jewelry, house-hold furniture, and much more.
Looking for a job? No problem. Waseet.net also helps you find jobs and post your CV online for recruiters and business owners to view directly on the Waseet.net 
For free and no intermediates, you can post your own ad on Waseet in one of the following categories:
Cars section which allows you to offer or search available cars for purchasing or leasing.
Real Estate section for selling and leasing apartments, houses, land, offices, and buildings
Job Vacancies section where you can post an available job at your company or upload your CV in the “Looking for a job” subcategory for recruiters to find and view.
Online classifieds section where you can sell electronics and home appliances, clothes, makeup, perfumes, watches, jewelry, bags, house-hold furniture, and much more. Plus, you can also post about any public service you provide like cleaning, painting, shipping, and transportation.

Connect your phone to your TV in seconds. No codes, no hassle.

Unlike many other remote apps, we’ve focused on real-world usability. Our team conducted extensive testing and reviewed thousands of user reviews to create an app that’s easy to use, responsive, and genuinely helpful — whether you’re at home, traveling, or managing multiple TVs.
