bluejetty:00162755:ios.description:
Jan-Navi Mahjong Online is a full-fledged mahjong game that you can play for free!
～Jan-Navi MahjongOnline has been running for over a decade. Both beginners and advanced players could enjoy this game without any pressure. ～
Jan-Navi Mahjong Online - Recommended for Mahjong Game Enthusiasts!
・If you are looking for a mahjong game that even beginner could enjoy it.
・If you are a beginner and want to train your mahjong skills or learn the basic rules of mahjong with a mahjong game.
・If you want to learn the yaku (hands) of mahjong.
・If you are looking for a free-to-play mahjong game.
・If you are looking for a casual and easy-to-play mahjong game.
・If you want to start enjoying mahjong for free.
■ Daily "Free Match" and "Rank Match" Events
Free Match and Rank Match are game modes that allow mahjong players nationwide to enjoy 4-player or 3-player mahjong matches.
You can test your mahjong skills with other players through online battles.
We introduce a combination rating system, including ranks and rates. Ranks are adjusted based on Agari points and rankings. Rates are calculated base on the difference in skill levels with opponents.
■ Weekly "Mahjong Events"
Mahjong Events are held every week, including team matches where you need to cooperate with friends, free battles to test your mahjong skilles, and county-based competitions.
■ "One Round Odyssey"
You can enjoy a single round mahjong match in 5 minutes while traveling around japan.
■ "Friend Match"
You can play mahjong with friends, whether they are nearby, faraway, or online.
It is free to you to set different rules or create your own mahjong parlor. You can even host a mahjong event yourself.
■ "Professional Match"
In professional matches, you can play mahjong with over 100 mahjong professionals from 6 organizations, as well as mahjong enthusiasts who are celebrities such as gravure idols and manga artists. This provides an opportunity for online matches with individuals who may not be accessible without going to a mahjong parlor or only available on TV.
■ "Mahjong Live Streaming"
During Friend Match, you can start a live stream for your mahjong match.
And you can watch other's live stream too.
Even in professional matches, professionals may provide live commentary, allowing you to learn real-time strategies for choosing tiles and more.
■ How to Play and Features
From beginners to experts, everybody can enjoy authentic mahjong in this game.
You can play mahjong casually witch opponents matching your skill level.
The detailed records of your performance allows you to analyze various tendencies, such as your preference for certain hand or the timing of declaring Richi in each round.
For mahjong beginners, they can check the hands or rules during the match.
You can also switch the display mode between landscape and portrait in setting menu.

bluejetty:00103377:android.description:
Email Go: Email Accounts, Online Mail, Free Secure Mailboxes
Read your email messages using only one shortcut email application- all the popular and most used email apps in one app now!
Email Go is a unified, all-in-one email app for Outlook 365, Spark, Webmail, AOL mail, ATT mail, Google mail and other email apps that lets you access and manage all your email accounts from different providers IN ONE PLACE! Why install tens of individual apps for each email account when you can access all of them with only one app?
Offering unparalleled speed and ease of use, this email app is the best way to organize and manage your emails and is the ideal inbox to handle your huge stock of mails.
Making use of cutting-edge technology, the app is designed to handle an unlimited number of mails
Easily access e-mails from unified accounts delivered in an intuitive design
Read emails, send emails, and check the inbox of all popular email providers with this Universal email app. Our mail app lets you access email accounts of:
- Gmail app
- Hotmail app
- MS Outlook App
- Zoho or Zoho mail
- Yahoo Mail App
- Office 365
- ATT Mail
- Spark
- AOL mail
- Webmail
- Post box
And many, many others!!
Another aspect that makes this all-in-one email app for gmail and other mail providers awesome is that it keeps your emails and all the information in them highly secure.
HIGHLIGHTS 
EASY ACCESS
Email Go enables you to connect, access, and manage as many email accounts as you have from different email providers. All the popular email apps can be accessed from one single app.
MULTIPLE ACCOUNTS IN ONE PLACE
No need to download multiple apps when you can use them all via every other mail app. Easier email messages handling using a single app to access all the above-mentioned email accounts and many more apart from them.
SEARCH BUILT FOR MOBILE EMAIL
Run the fastest search in all folders by contact or keywords on Email Go (Including super-large accounts).
UNDO SEND, DELETE, AND OTHER EMAIL ACTIONS
No regrets. Undo an e-mail even after it’s sent.
EASY TO ORGANIZE 
Message in a group and quick reply from notifications. Access launcher shortcuts for searching all inboxes or drafting new email messages. It is easy to switch between email account providers.
HANDLES UNLIMITED NUMB

Choose a suggestion as you type, then select a predicted ne
bluejetty:00135527:ios.description:
Type Khmer with word suggestions that learn from your selections. Find familiar words, add your own, and make your keyboard feel like yours on iPhone and iPad.
FIND FAMILIAR WORDS
Choose a suggestion as you type, then select a predicted next word. Suggestions adapt to the words you select, helping you find familiar words again. Add words you use often to your personal vocabulary.
MAKE IT YOURS
Choose light, dark, and colorful themes. Add emoji from the built-in panel. Some themes are available through in-app purchase.
EDIT WITH GESTURES
Move the cursor and delete text with keyboard gestures.
GET STARTED
1. Open iBoard and follow the setup guide.
2. Go to Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards and add iBoard.
3. Enable Allow Full Access for word suggestions. In a text field, use the globe key to switch to iBoard.
Start your next Khmer conversation with iBoard.

bluejetty:00121658:ios.summary:
Step into the New Generation of Minion Rush!

bluejetty:00121658:ios.description:
Step into the New Generation of Minion Rush!
Get ready to experience new adventures in Minion Rush, the ultimate endless running game! Packed with updated features, exciting challenges, and nonstop fun from Illumination's beloved Minions franchise, this refreshed experience is bigger, bolder, and better than ever!
Brought to you by Gameloft, in collaboration with Illumination and Universal Products & Experiences, Minion Rush delivers endless action, mischief, and surprises that you can play anytime, anywhere. Dive into a refreshed game and discover the despicable fun that only the Minions can bring! 
A Fresh New Look
Explore a revamped game with updated visuals, sleek UI, and modern designs. From reimagined locations to brand-new adventures, the design has been updated to keep the fun flowing!
Endless Run Action
Jump right into the action with the brand-new endless run mode! Push your skills to the limit, break records, and collect incredible rewards. Every run is a chance to chase glory!
Progress with the Hall of Jam
Collect bananas during your runs to unlock exciting rewards like new locations, Minion costumes, and fun features. 
Collect and Upgrade Minion Costumes
Run in style with an ever-expanding wardrobe of themed Minion costumes! Unlock Costume Collections packed with unique outfits and special bonuses to supercharge your runs. Collect exclusive themed stickers to bring your Minions to life with personality and flair!
Unique Gadgets for Extra Fun
Boost your gameplay with clever Gadgets! Pair them with your favorite costumes to customize your runs and discover endless possibilities.
Power-Up Your Runs
Go farther and faster with powerful power-ups! Unlock special abilities to maximize your performance and make every run unforgettable.
Exciting Tournaments
Unleash your competitive side with daily and weekly tournaments! Rise through the ranks, claim legendary rewards, and prove you're the ultimate Minion runner. Challenge players from around the globe and dominate the leaderboards!
Solve Story Puzzles
Dive into the Minions universe with Story Puzzles! Inspired by the iconic movies, Story Puzzles let you relive your favorite moments with your favorite Minions. It's puzzle fun you won't want to miss!
Personalize Your Player Profile
Showcase your achievements with customizable Player Profiles! Create your unique in-game identity with personalized nicknames, avatars, and frames. Compete with flair and climb the leaderboards in style.
Join more than a billion players worldwide and experience the mischief, mayhem, and nonstop fun of Minion Rush! 
___________________
You can download and play this game for free. Please note that it also allows play using virtual currency, which can be acquired as you progress through the game, by watching certain ads, or by paying with real money. Purchases of virtual currency using real money are made via a credit card or another payment method linked to your account, when you input your iTunes password. You will not be asked to re-enter your credit card number or PIN. Once your iTunes password is entered, your account will allow in-app purchases for 15 minutes. To restrict or disable in-app purchases, you can change your device settings.
This game contains ads for Gameloft products or third parties, which may redirect you to a third-party site. You can disable your device's ad identifier for interest-based ads in your device settings, under Settings -> Privacy -> Apple Advertising.
Certain aspects of this game will require players to connect to the Internet. 
Visit our official site at http://gmlft.co/website_EN
Check out the new blog at http://gmlft.co/central
Privacy Policy: http://www.gameloft.com/en/privacy-notice
Terms of Use: http://www.gameloft.com/en/conditions-of-use
End-User License Agreement: http://www.gameloft.com/en/eula

bluejetty:00119530:ios.summary:

Group insurance 
 · File all your healthcare claims online.

bluejetty:00119530:ios.description:
Discover Omni, the all-in-one app for your Desjardins group plans. 
Group insurance 
 · File all your healthcare claims online. 
 · Add receipts and other documents directly to your claim. 
 · Pull up your payment card in the app. 
 · Sign up for direct deposit and check your Health Spending Account balance (if included in your plan). 
 · Access other services such as telemedicine and the Health Is Cool 360 platform (if included in your plan). 
Group retirement savings 
 · Enroll in your group retirement savings program quickly and easily. 
 · Plan for the future by choosing your savings goals and beneficiaries. 
 · Choose your investments. 
 · Contribute to your savings any time and make withdrawals (if permitted under your plan).
 · View your statements, account details and returns. 
Get started with Omni 
Group insurance 
 · You’ll need your group and certificate numbers. You can find them on your payment card or insurance certificate. 
Group retirement savings 
 · You’ll need your group number and plan member or employee number. You can find them on your financial statements or get them from your plan sponsor. 
Be sure to read the terms of use when using the app for the first time. 
You can log in with fingerprint or facial biometrics, or with your password. 
Some app features may vary by plan or province.
Learn more about Omni: 
https://www.desjardins.com/en/business/solutions-tools/omni.html
See our Privacy Policy: 
https://www.desjardins.com/ca/privacy/privacy-policy/index.jsp

bluejetty:00121371:ios.description:
GeoShred Play Version 7
With In-App Purchases for GeoSWAM and Naada instruments on devices running iOS 13 or later.
With GeoShred Play, everyone can shred.
Play with confidence on GeoShred’s innovative diatonic playing surface, where every key can fit the scale. Slide your finger in any direction and let the music flow with expressive vibrato, seamless fretless playing, and GeoShred’s groundbreaking intelligent pitch rounding.
GeoShred Play is the play-only version of the award-winning GeoShred musical instrument for iPad, iPhone, and iPod touch. It is a great way to get started with GeoShred, giving you access to the expressive GeoShred performance surface and the ability to play GeoShred Pro presets.

bluejetty:00027104:ios.description:
AdGuard is an ultra-efficient ad blocker for Safari. It will not only remove annoying ads but also secure your privacy with advanced tracking protection. AdGuard for iOS is an open source app, it’s totally transparent and safe to use.
KEY FEATURES:
- Safari ad blocking. Removes all kinds of ads in Safari. Say goodbye to annoying banners, pop-ups and video ads. Whitelist your favorite websites or use manual blocking tool to hide any element on the page.
- Privacy protection. The web is full of trackers that literally watch your every click. AdGuard offers a selection of filters aimed directly at trackers and web analytics that will ensure your private data stays that way.
- Speed acceleration. Safari browser runs up to 4x faster. AdGuard removes tons of rubbish and you can freely surf the web!
- Reduced traffic consumption and increased battery life. Banners and ads sometimes add up to half the size of the page. By blocking them, you’re saving your battery life and Wi-Fi/mobile traffic.
- More than 50 popular subscriptions (EasyList, EasyPrivacy, etc.) plus AdGuard's own powerful ad filters, including language-specific filters. Together they don't leave ads a chance.
ADGUARD PRO FEATURES
AdGuard Pro includes the following features:
- Custom filters. Add your own filters by URL even if they are not on the default list.
- DNS privacy. Blocking regular online trackers is not enough if you want to assure 100% protection of your online privacy. Choose any of the user-favorite DNS providers or configure a custom DNS server.
- Security filters. Protect yourself from dangerous websites riddled with cryptojacking or fraud.
* Privacy policy: https://adguard.com/privacy.html
* Terms of Use: https://adguard.com/eula.html

AdGuard is a leading company in developing ad blocking software for multiple platforms. For more than ten years AdGuard has been helping millions of users enjoy safe, clean, and fast internet.
Follow us at @AdGuard on Twitter, facebook.com/AdGuardEn/ on FB or send us a message at support@adguard.com.

bluejetty:00166758:ios.summary:

TVs turn on and off. Planes lose radar. Radi
bluejetty:00166758:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
Shadowy cult members. Ghostly radio signals. Spacetime portals. Investigate a dark new mystery in this interactive story game set in a familiar world.
TVs turn on and off. Planes lose radar. Radio stations can't broadcast through the static. In the small coastal town of Camena, unnaturally occurring electromagnetic waves are suddenly causing interference with electrical and radio equipment. Reluctantly, Riley Poverly returns to her hometown to investigate the mystery, but what she finds is more than she bargained for.
OXENFREE II: Lost Signals is the mind-bending follow-up to the critically-acclaimed narrative adventure game OXENFREE from Night School, a Netflix Game Studio. Play the new story as a standalone, or dive deeper into the OXENFREE universe by playing the original to find connections — it's your choice. As you play, you'll shape the story through your choices. How you choose to deal with the supernatural events at hand will forever alter the future in this thrilling story.
YOUR CHOICES MATTER
• Shape everything through your conversations and dialogue choices: Forge a deep friendship with an old acquaintance from high school or opt to ignore a lost fisherman in need. 
• Your choices influence who Riley becomes, your relationships and the story options available to you.
START CHATTER FROM ANYWHERE
• Use an all-new walkie talkie conversation system to chat with contacts and uncover useful insights about the mysteries of Camena. Ask for info, check in with the locals, or completely ignore them. It's your call to make — and your choices have consequences.
STOP A MYSTERIOUS CULT
• Five years ago on nearby Edwards Island, a few teenagers unwittingly opened a portal, creating a rift between realities and timelines. Now, members of a mysterious cult-like group called Parentage are deliberately trying to open a new portal to pull something out. Who are they? What do they want? Are they trying to contact ghosts?
TUNE-IN TO THE RADIO
• Ghostly signals are piercing through the frequencies of Camena. Tap into the eerie sounds and static using OXENFREE's signature radio mechanic. 
• Communicate with the supernatural, manipulate the world and travel to the past by tuning into time tears: unnatural fissures in the time-space continuum.
SAVE EVERYONE AND EVERYTHING
• Your future was on the line in OXENFREE and those stakes are even higher in the story of OXENFREE II. 
• Explore, climb and rappel across Camena’s beautifully treacherous landscape. Take risks and see where the story takes you. It might be dangerous and scary. But it could also save the future. Not only for Riley but for everyone.
- Created by Night School, a Netflix Game Studio.

bluejetty:00026892:ios.description:
Lower your stress levels, reduce anxiety, overcome fears, relieve pain, get better sleep, and so much more. All made possible with access to hundreds of meditations in the Tapping Solution App. You'll learn how to use Tapping (also known as EFT, or Emotional Freedom Techniques), to lead a happier and healthier life.
Over 15 million sessions completed so far, ranging in length from 2 minutes (a quick session) to 20 minutes (to guide your deeper work). 
"Like someone turned off the anxiety switch." - Debbie, App member
"This is one of the most calming and tools in my mindfulness toolkit." -App member
"I'm 46 and struggled with a racing mind at bedtime and anxiety my whole life. I'm shocked that as I do this before sleep, I feel like I got the deep, restorative sleep my body with fibromyalgia needs to heal." -Susie, App member
Tapping has also been recommended by top doctors, therapists, psychologists, personal development experts, and mental health experts including Mark Hyman, M.D., Tony Robbins, Ruth Buczynski, Ph.D., Dawson Church, Ph.D., Brendon Burchard, Eric Leskowitz, M.D., and many others! 
Clinical Research About The App Published in A Top-Tier Journal: 
A recent study conducted on the Tapping Solution App's effectiveness of immediate reduction of psychological distress concluded that there was statistically significant reduction in the emotional intensity ratings between the start and end of sessions for stress and anxiety sessions, thus offering preliminary evidence on the immediate effects of The Tapping Solution App in reducing psychological distress.
Follow along effortlessly with Meditations designed for you to get lasting results. Topics include: 
* Lowering stress about: family, finances, health, work, the world & more
* Sleep support for: insomnia, fall asleep faster, quiet your racing mind & more
* Releasing emotions such as: anger, anxiety, fear, grief, guilt, sadness, self-doubt, shame & more
* Relief from pain such as: arthritis, back pain, cancer pain, endometriosis, fibromyalgia, headaches, knee pain, neck pain, sciatic pain & more
* Supporting your body in healing from: allergies, colds, high blood pressure, inflammation, indigestion, tinnitus, TMJ & more
* Women's health support for: early motherhood, fertility, IVF, menopause, pregnancy & more
* Weight loss & body confidence support for: critical self-talk, eliminating cravings, getting back on track & more
* Support for children, military/veterans & teachers.
Subscription Pricing and Terms:
Auto-renewing monthly subscription & auto-renewing yearly subscriptions are offered, both of which allow full access to all content for as long as you maintain an active subscription.
A lifetime subscription, which is a one-time-only payment, is also offered, giving unlimited access to all of the content inside the app forever.
Prices are set in US dollars. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country.
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes account at the time of the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period end date, and the cost of the renewal will be listed. You can manage your subscription and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. 
The information presented in this app, including introducing EFT Tapping is not intended to represent that Tapping is used to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or psychological disorder. Tapping is not a substitute for medical or psychological treatment. We strongly advise that you seek professional advice as appropriate before making any health decision.
Read more about the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy here: https://bit.ly/2UFLd02

bluejetty:00100359:ios.name: Boisvert Analog Horror Game
bluejetty:00100359:ios.summary:
Dive into the Static: The Ultimate _Boisvert Horror Experience
From the fractured recesses of the digital void comes "Boisvert: Analog Horror Game," a terrifying descent into the human psyche that pushes the boundaries of the horror game g
bluejetty:00100359:ios.description:
Dive into the Static: The Ultimate _Boisvert Horror Experience
From the fractured recesses of the digital void comes "Boisvert: Analog Horror Game," a terrifying descent into the human psyche that pushes the boundaries of the horror game genre. Based on the enigmatic and unsettling _boisvert web series, this game plunges players into a cold, monochromatic world where isolation is not just a feeling it is a physical threat. You are trapped in a desolate house for 5 nights, tasked with a single, harrowing objective: survive the creeping darkness and the malevolent gaze of the entity known as Room.
A Descent into Madness
The Boisvert phenomenon is more than a creepypasta; it is a surreal allegory for depression, anxiety, and the terrifying "Complex" that lives within us all. This game faithfully recreates the grainy, VHS aesthetic of analog horror, transporting players into a glitch-filled reality where the laws of physics bend to the will of shadows. As you navigate the silence of the house, you will uncover the lore behind the cryptic figures Ouriel, Dogtooth, and the terrifying Room. peeling back the layers of a narrative that blurs the line between terror and tragedy.
Gameplay: Survive the Complex
"Boisvert" delivers a heart-pounding blend of psychological thriller and survival horror mechanics. The gameplay is designed to test your mental endurance as much as your reflexes:
5 Nights of Terror: Endure a week of escalating fear. Each night brings new psychological torments and aggressive behaviors from the entities roaming the halls.
Analog Surveillance: Utilize a retro computer interface and static-filled cameras to monitor the "noises downstairs." Keep Room at bay while deciphering cryptic text.
Puzzle-Solving Dread: The house is a puzzle box of trauma. Solve abstract riddles and manipulate your environment to prevent the Complex from consuming you entirely.
The Face of Fear
In the pantheon of horror games, few antagonists are as unsettling as Room. The Room is not merely an entity; he is a silent, looming judgment. The game utilizes a unique soundscape of distorted whispers and low-frequency hums to create an atmosphere of suffocating dread. Every shadow could be an enemy; every glitch in the analog feed could be a warning. This is terror in its purest form; quiet, relentless, and deeply personal.
Why Play Boisvert?
"Boisvert" is a love letter to the analog horror and creepypasta communities, offering a deeply immersive experience that rivals logic. It challenges players to face their inner fear in a literal sense. As the nights progress, the barrier between the game and your reality thins. Will you find the will to "Step Outside," or will you be lost in the static forever?
Key Features:
Authentic VHS Aesthetic: stunning analog visuals with authentic tape distortion and glitch effects.
Psychological Lore: A deep narrative based on the hidden meanings of the _boisvert series.
Survival Mechanics: Resource management and strategic surveillance gameplay inspired by the classic 5 nights formula.
Prepare yourself for an experience that will linger long after you turn off the screen.

bluejetty:00141667:ios.summary: The official WION News app helps you have the world at your feet - quite literally. Not only does it brings the international news updates to the common Indian reader, it also takes India far and wide -- to other countries and continents.
bluejetty:00141667:ios.description:
The official WION News app helps you have the world at your feet - quite literally. Not only does it brings the international news updates to the common Indian reader, it also takes India far and wide -- to other countries and continents.
Be it Latest U.S Headlines, Political Views, US Entertainment News & Gossips or USA Sports News, you name it, and you get it here on the WION news app. The Breaking News alert feature helps you get to know of any major event as and when it happens -- in any part of the world.
This world news app works in conjunction with the WION news channel -- a first-of-its-kind 'global' news channel. With its special focus on South Asia the WION news channel takes the region to the West, and vice-versa.
With the LIVE TV option on the app, you can watch Live News coverage of major events on the app. Get the best of the WION news channel -- Gravitas -- on your fingertips.
The WION app also brings to you some of the best articles, analyses and commentary, and opinion pieces written by trusted and superlative news editors and columnists.
Fast and accurate updates on the WION news app will ensure that you find the World's latest news, US Top headlines, Hollywood News, US Trending News on your fingertips. The app is built especially for iOS devices.
WHAT YOU GET WHEN YOU DOWNLOAD THE WION APP :
* Breaking News developments, News from the World, South Asia, and latest political issues
* Get engaging and entertaining news stories from Hollywood, Bollywood and theatre space
* Live coverage from News, Sports, Technology, Entertainment events
* Latest news in form of images and videos including ground reports from Washington.
* Business news, latest updates from Economy, Market and Industry
* Science news, latest discoveries, news and updates about space-related stories and other discoveries from around the world
* Technology news, Gadget and Smartphone Reviews, Apps and Social media news
* International news, Viral and Trending stories from around the world
TOP FEATURES OF THE WION APP INCLUDE:
* Live TV: Never miss a news update. Watch WION news channel anytime, anywhere
* Customised home screen: Select sections of your interest to appear on your home screen. You can even reorder them according to your preference
* Next story: Read the next story conveniently by just swiping left
* Share news: Share articles, photos and videos via Facebook, Twitter, Google Plus, WhatsApp, e-mail and SMS text messages
* Manage notifications: Select the categories you want to receive notifications for
* Mark favourite : You can bookmark articles, videos and photos so that you can later come back to them
* Offline reading: You need not worry when you don't have internet access. Use this feature to read news even when you are offline
* Videos: Browse through a selection of most informative and entertaining video clips
* Photos: Photo galleries and slideshows on latest news, entertainment, sports, business and lifestyle
Download the official WION app today to get the exhaustive news coverage by WION's large network, and to easily access latest news, features, photos, videos from India and across the world on your smartphones. The app is built for iOS devices.
For more info visit our Website : https://www.wionews.com/
and follow us on :
* Twitter - https://twitter.com/WIONews
* Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/WIONews

bluejetty:00122665:ios.description:
Dow Credit Union is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to manage your accounts, with many features to make your banking experience personalized, faster and more convenient. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Dow Credit Union:
• Keep your transactions organized by adding tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
• Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
• Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
• Transfer money between your accounts, and with accounts you hold at other financial institutions
• Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
• View and save your monthly statements
• Find branches and ATMs near you
• Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices.
To use the Dow Credit Union Mobile App, you must be enrolled as a Dow Credit Union Online Banking user. If you currently use our Online Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and sign in with the same Online Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00173090:ios.description:
Introducing the AI Photo Editor app – your one-stop solution for transforming ordinary photos into extraordinary masterpieces! Our groundbreaking app combines advanced AI technology with a user-friendly interface, allowing anyone to produce stunning, professional-grade images with just a few taps. Dazzle your friends and followers with striking, AI-enhanced photos that set you apart from the rest.
Key Features:
– Background Eraser & Replacer: Effortlessly remove distracting backgrounds and conjure up spectacular new ones with a simple text prompt. Transport yourself to a cosmic landscape or any other fantastic setting in a flash!
– Object & Person Remover: Flawlessly erase unwanted objects or people from your photos, ensuring your images stay pristine and true to your artistic vision. The feature is not intended to remove watermarks.
– Image Upscaling: Revitalize faded or low-quality photos by enhancing and upscaling them to high-resolution, guaranteeing consistently polished results.
– Comprehensive Editing Solution: Simplify your editing process with all essential tools consolidated in one handy app, making your workflow more efficient.
– AI-Powered Photos for Social Media: Astonish your friends and followers with attention-grabbing, AI-enhanced photos that help you stand out from the crowd.
The AI Photo Editor app is ideal for anyone seeking to wow their friends and followers with spectacular photos. Our app's intuitive design ensures that even novices in photo editing can swiftly create captivating images that will leave their audience speechless.
Unleash the potential of AI-driven photo editing with the AI Photo Editor app. Download now and immerse yourself in the future of photo editing at your fingertips!

The AI Photo Editor is a subscription-based app. Sample it for free with a trial period and subscribe for unlimited access. No commitment, cancel anytime.
Manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in Account Settings in iTunes after purchase.
Please note that this app is intended for creative purposes and does not support the removal of watermarks or any other copyrighted materials.

bluejetty:00184131:ios.description:
Buscando um aplicativo para gestão financeira do seu investimento? Controle sua carteira e acompanhe suas ações e dividendos com poucos cliques. Baixe o app!
O Dividendos é um app feito de investidor para investidores, desenvolvido para ser seu aliado no controle de investimentos em real ou dólar. Conecte-se com o Portal do Investidor da B3, tenha acesso a dezenas de gráficos automatizados e monitore seus investimentos em diferentes instituições financeiras. 
Integrações Automatizadas
Controlar os seus investimentos ficou ainda mais fácil. Tenha acesso à integrações automatizadas e receba atualizações de rendimentos em tempo real. Monitore suas ações da Bolsa de Valores, Fundos Imobiliários, Tesouro Direto, Fundos de Investimentos ou Criptoativos e fique por dentro da rentabilidade da sua carteira em um só app.
Gráficos Otimizados
O app com o maior número de gráficos do mercado financeiro. Acompanhe os rendimentos da sua carteira de investimentos e receba insights que te auxiliam na tomada de decisão. 
Acompanhe Ativos
Com poucos cliques, você consegue acompanhar ativos e ações do seu interesse: entenda as oscilações do valor da ação e receba alertas quando o ativo alcançar o preço alvo. Além disso, você recebe notificações de recomendações de compra por empresas do seu interesse, através do recurso "carteiras recomendadas".
Melhores Proventos
Acompanhe seu calendário de proventos e os valores que serão pagos dos seus dividendos, além de ter acesso às listagens dos maiores proventos do Brasil e EUA.
Comece a Investir
Controle todos os eventos da sua carteira de investimentos em um só lugar! Consulte os gráficos e decida onde investir: tesouro direto, ações, bolsa de valores americana, criptomoedas, BDRs, FIIs, Fundos de Investimentos ou ETFs.
Recursos Premium
Acompanhe sua carteira de um jeito mais completo com a versão Premium. Você pode monitorar os seus investimentos e rentabilidade das ações da Bolsa de Valores e de toda a sua carteira com análises avançadas, além de ter uma visualização mais ampla e detalhada dos seus rendimentos e dividendos.
Quer saber mais? Acesse nosso site ou Baixe o app!
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00097064:ios.description:
Welcome to Sweet Escape: Candy Park! Merge, renovate, and solve the mystery of this magical place. 
In this journey, players will navigate the tumultuous story of a mother, Lucy, who was betrayed by her husband, making the courageous decision to divorce for the sake of her tearful daughter. However, in a twist of fate, they both tumble into the daughter's fairytale world – a forgotten Candy park in need of repair and rejuvenation.
As players, you are tasked with the vital mission of rebuilding the once joyful amusement park, piece by piece, through engaging and inventive synthesis puzzles. With each structure restored and every challenge overcome, you'll not only bring the park back to its former glory and will also discover more secrets about your husband and the third person Fox.
Game Features:
- **Deep Emotional Narrative**:
Experience a story that touches on themes of betrayal, resilience, and the enduring power of love between a mother and her daughter.
- **Engaging Synthesis Gameplay**
 Solve unique puzzles by merge different elements to recreate the Candyland's attractions and facilities, ensuring hours of captivating gameplay.
- **Vibrant Fairytale World**:
Explore a richly imagined candy-themed park, filled with colorful environments, whimsical characters, and magical surprises around every corner.
- **Heart-touching Adventure**:
Join our heroines on their quest not only to return to reality but to discover the true essence of family, forgiveness, and a fresh start.
Sweet Escape: Candy Park perfect for players of all ages looking for a journey that combines emotional depth with fun, interactive gameplay. Unite the mother and daughter, rebuild the wonders of candy park, and find your way back home through the power of love and collaboration.
Download "Sweet Escape: Candy Park" now and embark on a journey that's as sweet as it is inspiring!

DOMO — Uyingiz uchun yagona kommunal ilova
DOMO — bu O‘zbekistondagi barcha kommunal va uy bilan bog‘liq xizmatlarni bitta ilovada jamlagan zamonaviy platforma. Endi turli ilovalarni yuklab yurishingiz shart emas — DOMO hammasini bir joyda taklif qiladi.

• Elektr, gaz, suv, chiqindi, internet, XUJMSh va TV xizmatlari uchun to‘lovlar
• “Mening uyim” xizmatlari bo‘yicha to‘lovlarni boshqarish
• Yuridik shaxslar uchun gaz va elektr energiyasi bo‘yicha to‘lovlar va hisob-kitoblar
• DOMO XAYRIYA — masjidlar uchun kommunal ehson qilish
• Sun’iy intellekt asosidagi kommunal tahlil
• Kunlik, haftalik va oylik iste’mol sarfini kuzatish
• Real vaqt rejimida balansni tekshirish
• Har bir to‘lov uchun 2% gacha keshbek
• Barcha to‘lovlar tarixini bitta joyda saqlash
• Referal keshbek orqali daromad olish
• 24/7 qo‘llab-quvvatlash xizmati
DOMO qulay interfeys, tezkor ishlash va ishonchli to‘lov tizimi bilan yaratilgan. Ilova doimiy ravishda yangilanib boradi, texnik kamchiliklar bartaraf etiladi va yangi imkoniyatlar qo‘shiladi.
DOMO — bu shunchaki to‘lov ilovasi emas.
Bu sizning uyingiz bilan bog‘liq barcha masalalarda ishonchli raqamli yordamchingiz.
DOMO’ni yuklab oling va kommunal hayotingizni yengillashtiring.
DOMO — The only utility app for your home
DOMO is a modern platform that brings together all utility and home-related services in Uzbekistan into a single app. No more downloading and using multiple applications — DOMO offers everything in one place.
With DOMO, you can:
• Pay for electricity, gas, water, waste collection, internet, HOA/management services, and TV 
• Manage payments for “My Home” services 
• Pay for gas and electricity for legal entities, including billing and calculations
• DOMO CHARITY — make utility donations for mosques 
• Use AI-powered utility analytics 
• Track daily, weekly, and monthly consumption 
• Check your balance in real time 
• Get up to 2% cashback on every payment 
• Keep all payment history in one place 
• Earn through referral cashback 
• Access 24/7 customer support
DOMO is built with a user-friendly interface, fast performance, and a secure payment system. The app is continuously updated, technical issues are resolved, and new features are regularly added.
DOMO is not just a payment app. 
It is your reliable digital assistant for everything related to your home.
Download DOMO and make your utility life easier.

Streak freezes step in automatically, so one off day doesn't break your streak: 1 per h
bluejetty:00041740:ios.description:
Focus On is a habit tracker and focus timer made for ADHD brains. If any of these sound familiar, it was built for you:
"One missed day and I give up."
Streak freezes step in automatically, so one off day doesn't break your streak: 1 per habit each month, 3 with Premium.
"I never know where to start."
Pick ready-made habits like Take meds, Drink water or Deep work block, and tick them off from one Today screen.
"I forget until it's too late."
A calm morning reminder tells you how many habits are on today and which one to start with. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets keep them in sight.
"I can't get going."
Pomodoro sprints turn big tasks into short blocks. Run several timers at once and follow them on your Lock Screen with Live Activities.
"My phone keeps pulling me away."
Deep Focus blocks the apps you pick until your session ends. One session a day is free. It needs Screen Time permission, and you can end a session early.
"Nothing ever feels like progress."
Celebrations at 7, 30, 100 and 365 days, plus a year view that fills in every day you show up.
Premium
Unlimited Deep Focus sessions, scheduled and Pomodoro blocking, 3 streak freezes per habit each month, unlimited habits and timers, iCloud sync, all themes and no ads.
Focus On is an independent app and is not affiliated with Focusmate Inc.
==============================
Subscriptions
Focus On is free to download. Premium is available as an auto-renewing subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Available plans and prices are shown in the app before you buy and may vary by country. Some plans include a free trial.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage your subscriptions or turn off auto-renew in your Apple Account settings at any time after purchase.
• If you cancel, your subscription stays active until the end of the current period.
• Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/timer1/terms
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/timer1/privecy_policy

bluejetty:00123684:ios.description:
■ Game Introduction
"Animal Hot Springs" is an idle 'casual' management game. 
Run your hot springs successfully to make it the most popular place ever.
You can earn acorns from animals visited.
Buy various bath items and upgrade the facilities with your acorns.
■ Game Features
- Easy, simple and idle management game that anyone can enjoy easily
- Bathing animals look so cute and adorable to look at
- Facility upgrades offering automatic acorn earning
- increase the reputation of the hot springs to invite all the animals
■ How to play
- You can earn acorns from animal visitors.
- Purchase a variety of bath goods in advance with your acorns and provide them properly.
- Satisfy your animals by providing bath goods properly and get the VIP stamps.
- Various facilities in lounge will help you increase your reputation and earn more acorns.
- Higher reputation enables you to invite more diverse animals.
- Collect all the hidden animals to reach the highest level.
- The sauna is open!! Invite new animals to the sauna.
- Turn on the brazier and animals will come to enjoy.
- Bake food on the brazier and animals love it!
- The animals in the sauna give you golden acorns.
- You can change the background of the hot springs.
- The animals in the sauna give you golden acorns.
■ Save Data
This game saves data to your device.
If you delete the game, your game progress will be lost.
■ Developer E-mail: superthumb2015@gmail.com

bluejetty:00071027:ios.description:
Hearts War was once the most popular classic card game in Microsoft Windows. Now after being redesigned by Goldenwood, it will be presented in the App Store with a better gaming experience and newer features for free downloads! If you are a fan of classic card game , you will love this game!
Hearts In some countries and regions, is also called the Queen of Spades. Hong Kong and Taiwan regions call it the Sad Little Stack.
Rules are simple: Four people participate in the rounds of cards, according to the ranking order to play the same suit or layup, try to earn the lowest score by avoiding hearts...and especially by avoiding the 13-point Q Spades! The goal is to get the lowest points in each hand.
Gameplay:
The first round: The player holding the 2 Club starts the game by having to throw 2 Club first. Other players choose cards with the same suit. If they don’t, they can use cards of other suits. At the end of a round of cards, except for players of different suits from the first card player, the player with the highest number of points wins the card to get the next round of cards. Remember, even if the cards played in the first round are layups, cards with scoring such as hearts and Q Spade cannot be played.
From the second round: The player throws cards of the same suit in a clockwise order. If there is no card, other cards can be played. In the second round, a score card can be played. When the first heart card appears, the scene is called ‘heartbreak’, which means that after the next round, all players can play any heart card.
Shoot the Moon
It is a special card game strategy, which refers to wining all the cards with points. At the end of the game, he gets 0 points, and all opponents +26 points. 
Heart War Features:
-Easy to play, easy to be master.
-Creative collection feature, unlock unique background music
-Intelligent AI opponents to play with: There are three difficulty levels to choose from
-Standard rule: each heart card has 1 point, and Q Spade has 13 points in a round, totaling 26 points.
-Optional rules: you can choose whether to include J in the scoring range, if included, J will be recorded as -10 points
-Customize game ending points: 50, 100, 150 points
-High-quality solitaire card faces, card backs, backgrounds
-Fun and amazing game effects animation
-The game process is automatically saved, and you can come to a game anytime, anywhere
If you are professional hearts card game player, this expert hearts game is sure to be your favorite! Download Classic Hearts free today! Download it now!
-----------------------------------------------
Subscription
Hearts Premium Subscription gives you access to seamless play without any ads and exclusive game themes.
You can subscribe to Premium for $1.99 per Month or $4.99 per 3 Months or $9.99 per Year. New subscribers can choose a one-week trial subscription at no cost. 
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account on confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews monthly or annually depending on the subscription type purchased. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period ($1.99 per Month or $4.99 per 3 Months or $9.99 per Year, depending on the subscription type purchased). You can turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. If auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period, you will not be charged for the next period. All cancellations will take effect at the end of the current period.
Privacy: http://www.mygoldenwood.com/privacy.html
Terms of Service: http://www.mygoldenwood.com/service.html

Welcome to HEAVENHELLS, an anime RPG where your tactical strategy is the only thing standing between humanity and oblivion.
When Purgatory tore open and Hellions poured into our world, everything we called normal crumbled in an instant.
But from the ashes of disaster, girls wielding extraordinary power began to emerge—the only ones capable of fighting back against the demonic threat.
The world calls them WiTCHes.
As their newly appointed Captain, you're humanity's last hope.
Their lives, and our future, rest in your hands.

Tactical Team-Building – Master each WiTCH's unique abilities and synergies to create the ultimate squad.

Living, Breathing Characters – Watch them respond to your every interaction with realistic expressions, eye contact, and breathing animations.
Bonds Beyond the Battlefield – Share their daily lives, worries, and small moments of joy. Discover sides of them that only you will ever see.
■ A Story Told Like an Anime Come Alive
High Cinematic Production Value – Experience an immersive story directed with mainstream TV-quality anime graphics and emotional depth.
A Journey of Trust and Growth – Unravel the truth behind the disaster while forging unbreakable bonds with your WiTCHes.
Captain, your WiTCHes are waiting.
Step into command now.

bluejetty:00159442:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00159442:ios.description:
FIND DJS & MUSICIANS
Discover thousands of DJs, bands, and musicians all over the globe, ready to play at your event. There's an artist for any occasion and event. Need to set the mood at an opening party? There's someone who knows how to do it. Want to make your wedding even more memorable? There's an extraordinary DJ and an energetic band ready for you. Or do you need to throw a spontaneous '90s party this weekend? We'll sort you out.
HIRE A DJ, BAND, OR MUSICIAN - IN MINUTES
It doesn't matter if your event is tonight or a year from now, when you've found an artist you like, you can hire them within minutes. Pay easily with card or with cash directly at the event.
UPFRONT PRICES AND TERMS
See upfront prices and what services are included before making your booking - you'll always know exactly what you're getting. You'll also get a clear overview of the artists' terms and when is the latest day you can cancel and still get a full refund. 
BE PROTECTED FROM CANCELLATIONS
In the extremely rare case that an artist cancels on you, we'll automatically refund your entire payment. Next, you can easily pick a backup artist to perform at the event. You'll feel safe and fully protected. 
MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE
Unsatisfied with the performance? You'll get your money back if you've paid through Cueup. Read more about the terms on our website. 
CHOOSE AN ARTIST THAT MATCH YOUR EVENT
Use our filtering options to easily find an artist that meets your needs. You can find a DJ that plays vinyl or any music genre you might want such as Bollywood, HipHop, Techno, or just the latest top 40 songs to get the crowd going. Or if you need a band that plays 90's rock, you'll find that too. You'll also have the option to filter by price and extra services such as MC'ing, party lights, included sound system, and more.
------- FOR ARTISTS -------
GET BOOKED EASILY
Become listed on Cueup's website and get booked to perform at events. You'll get notifications when someone wants to book you, new chat messages, or other updates for events you're playing at.
CHAT WITH EVENT ORGANIZERS AND TAKE PAYMENTS
Send offers for events and chat with the organizer to decide a price. You can quickly check the status of your gig, if it has been paid, or if the organizer is still deciding. When the organizer is ready to book, you can accept card payments, cash at the event, or set your own custom payment instructions.
PLAY GIGS ANYWHERE
Have you ever dreamed about playing a gig abroad? You can set up multiple locations and receive gigs at your dream destinations. 
CHOOSE GIGS THAT MATCH YOUR SKILLS
Do you only want to play a certain genre of music? No problem - just set your music genres in the app. There's no pressure to play a gig, you can always pass on a gig that you don't feel comfortable playing.
BE PROTECTED FROM CANCELLATIONS AND COMPLAINTS
Specify your own cancellation policy and make sure you get paid - even if someone cancels on you last minute. If a customer complains, we'll handle the fuss, and protect you from any uncomfortable situations.
MAKE YOUR PROFILE STAND OUT
Keep your artist profile up to date with mixes, images, testimonials, and more. It's easy to update any detail and receive our recommendations on how to make your profile stand out.
See more here: https://cueup.io
Privacy policy: https://cueup.io/terms/privacy
Terms: https://cueup.io/terms

bluejetty:00167920:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the tranquil world of coloring with Calm Color - Color by Number, the ultimate relaxation destination in coloring apps.
Indulge in a peaceful experience similar to flipping through a real coloring book, all within the comfort of your device. Designed for adults seeking a serene pastime, Calm Color provides tranquility and ease amidst the hustle and bustle of everyday life.
Whether during a busy commute, a tense work break, or a quiet evening, Calm Color can be your ideal choice for relaxing your mind and relieving stress. Just imagine:
- Walking down a peaceful path lined with flowers, listening to the soft singing of birds, and experiencing the serenity and vitality of nature.
- Sitting by the fireplace on a cold winter's day, sipping hot coffee, feeling warm and peaceful throughout your body.
- Sitting in a serene Chinese courtyard, Admiring the poetic garden landscape while listening to the melodious sound of the zither.
Calm Color can take you into these wonderful moments, allowing your mind to relax and heal.
With various features, including Calm Color—Color by Number, this free adult coloring app provides an enjoyable painting experience. Explore intricate floral patterns or captivating landscapes as you let your creativity flow freely. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced artist, Calm Color meets all skill levels with its intuitive digital coloring system.
Why Choose Calm Color?
- Realistic Coloring Book Experience: 
Feel like you are holding a real coloring book through Calm Color's realistic interface. Click on each color number to bring each image back to life!
- Relaxation and Serenity:
 Enjoy peaceful moments while escaping from stress; find yourself achieving happiness and satisfaction through coloring.
- A wide variety of designs: 
Choose from a diverse selection of calming designs, including flowers, animals, mandalas, and landscapes, and take a coloring journey through different regions of the world. Experience the beauty of Chinese, Japanese, European, and American styles.
- User-friendly interface: 
Easily navigate through the app's features and functions for a seamless coloring experience. Calm Color focus on user experience and meeting user needs.
- Wonderful music selection: 
We have a rich library of soothing music where you can immerse yourself in relaxing melodies as you bring these realistic images to life.
In this fast-paced world, take ten minutes for yourself and open Calm Color - Color by Number to explore the world of coloring. Have a peaceful conversation with your soul!

McColly Real Estate, the #1 independent brokerage and local business in the GNIAR MLS, brings the most accurate and up-to-date real estate information to your phone or mobile device! Use the McColly app anytime, anywhere to pull up homes for sale around your location using the GPS search, or find homes based on address, city or zip code. McColly Real Estate is also an exclusive member of Leading Real Estate Companies of the World®.

bluejetty:00144732:ios.name: Countryballs at War
bluejetty:00144732:ios.summary: Countryballs at War is a grand strategy wargame where you take control of a countryball nation and fight for world domination. Combine turn-based empire building with real-time battles, expand your territory, and rise as the ultimate superp
bluejetty:00144732:ios.description:
Countryballs at War is a grand strategy wargame where you take control of a countryball nation and fight for world domination. Combine turn-based empire building with real-time battles, expand your territory, and rise as the ultimate superpower!
Key Features
Diplomacy & Conquest
Declare war or form alliances with other nations. Sign peace treaties, send alliance requests, and even puppet weakened countries to expand your influence. Choose your allies wisely – rivals will attempt to capture your territories and defeat your nation!
Turn-Based Strategy
Plan each move carefully. Every turn, you receive a limited number of Attack Points for military actions and Diplomacy Points for negotiations. Use them wisely to conquer territory or sway other nations before ending the turn. Invest in Academies to increase these point limits and gain a strategic edge.
Real-Time Battles
Lead your armies on the battlefield in live combat. Send units across enemy borders and coordinate attacks in real time. Call your allies for backup to turn the tide of battle, and outsmart your enemies with superior tactics to achieve victory on the field!
Unique Units & Upgrades
Unlock and upgrade special units unique to each country. Build infantry, tanks, artillery and more in your Barracks and Artillery Depot. Each countryball nation has unique military units and strengths – develop your forces and prepare for new units coming in future updates.
World Events & Challenges
Stay alert for dynamic world events like the Pirate Invasion, where pirates attack coastal territories. These random challenges will test your strategic planning – be ready to defend your ports and borders at any moment.
All Countries Playable
Choose any countryball to lead! Every country is available to play, though some start out locked. Explore the map to find hidden countryballs and unlock new playable nations. (Use the “Get Hint!” button in-game if you need clues to find them.)
Offline Single-Player
Enjoy all the strategic depth anytime – no internet required. Countryballs at War is fully playable offline and offers a robust single-player experience, perfect for strategy enthusiasts on the go.
Community & Support
The game is updated frequently with new content, units, and improvements. Join our community on Discord to discuss strategies, share feedback, and get the latest news (link below). If you enjoy Countryballs at War, please support us by leaving a rating and review – your feedback helps us continue improving the game!
Discord: https://discord.gg/Fx2D6MQZkC
Have fun leading your country to victory in Countryballs at War!
Credits
Map Music: "Gates of Glory" by Alexander Nakarada (serpentsoundstudios.com) – Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

bluejetty:00077835:ios.description:
FITIV Sync for Fitbit will sync your Fitbit workout and health data to Apple Health, allowing you to sync this data between iOS apps. Unlock your data and keep your health in sync with FITIV Sync for Fitbit.
FITIV Sync for Fitbit can sync any or all of the following metrics from Fitbit to Apple Health:
- Flights Climbed
- Steps
- Workouts
- Body Mass Index (BMI)
- Body Fat Percentage
- Weight
- Calories Consumed
- Water
- Sleep Analysis
Only want to sync some of your Fitbit data to Apple Health? FITIV Sync for Fitbit’s syncing is completely customizable. Select only the metrics you want to sync, no need to clutter Apple Health with data you don’t care to track.
Looking to sync your health data to other iOS apps? FITIV Sync for Fitbit unlocks your health and workout data, putting you in charge of your own health history. No need to choose between your Fitbit and your other favorite iOS apps, your data is yours to sync and analyze. 
FITIV Sync for Fitbit is a FITIV app. Are you making the move from Fitbit to Apple Watch? FITIV Pulse gives you all of the in-depth workout analysis you need to take charge of your fitness with a fully customizable daily health dashboard to give you insight about your health as a whole. 
Want to learn more about FITIV? 
https://www.fitiv.com/
https://www.facebook.com/fitivapp/
https://www.instagram.com/fitivapp/

 Track your usage, pay your bill with one tap, manage your connections, and enjoy exclusive gifts and benefits with Cyta Rewards. The app is designed for everyon
bluejetty:00071704:ios.description:
With the My Cyta app, you’re in control of your services — easily and quickly!
 Track your usage, pay your bill with one tap, manage your connections, and enjoy exclusive gifts and benefits with Cyta Rewards. The app is designed for everyone, with accessibility features that support different needs, such as larger text and assistive tools. 
You can also:
• Top-up soeasy numbers
• Pay bills and top-up using your credit or debit card
• Save your card for faster future payments
• Activate or transfer your eSIM
• Purchase and verify a new soeasy connection
• Order products and services
• Manage add-ons for your services
• Set or change your roaming limit
• View and manage your My Cyta account
Important information:
• To register on My Cyta you just need to own or use a Cyta service (Postpaid mobile, internet, Cytavision, Telephony, soeasy). 
• You can add on your account, any Cyta mobile service that you use and manage it from the app.
• For more information, you can visit the My Cyta app page
What’s New:
In this version, enjoy an improved experience focused on usability and security. Sign in easily with biometrics and get things done faster and simpler.

bluejetty:00024232:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone into a translation device! 
Introducing iTranslate Converse, a revolutionary new speech translation App. iTranslate Converse turns your iPhone and Apple Watch into a two-way translation device. The simple design enables natural conversations in 38 languages, and automatically detects the correct language between two selected languages for a fast and accurate translation.
Speak directly into your iPhone’s microphone and dramatically improve results as well as create a more natural conversation experience. It literally turns your iPhone into the first real translation device.
SIMPLE & EASY
Tap & Hold to Speak. Release to Translate. The entire screen becomes your translation button.
SUPERIOR TRANSLATION ACCURACY
Works well in noisy environments.
BLAZING FAST
Delivers translation results in near real time.
38 LANGUAGES
Instantly converse in 38 languages.
LANGUAGE DETECTION
Automatic detection between the 2 selected languages for a seamless translation experience.
TRANSCRIPTS
View and export full transcripts for every voice conversation.
Learn more about iTranslate Converse at https://www.itranslate.com/converse
SUPPORT
Visit https://www.itranslate.com/support/ or contact us at help@itranslate.com
Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/iTranslateApp
Like & share on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/itranslateapp
Learn more about iTranslate: https://www.itranslate.com
Supported languages & dialects for translation:
Arabic (Saudi), Arabic (UAE), Arabic (Egypt), Catalan, Chinese (Mandarin), Chinese (Taiwan), Chinese (Cantonese), Czech, Danish, Dutch, English (US), English (GB), English (Australian), Finnish, French, French (Canada), German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese (Portugal), Portuguese (Brazil), Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Spanish (Spain), Spanish (USA), Spanish (Mexico), Swedish, Thai, Turkish
For a Complete Language overview: https://itranslate.com/languages
---
Auto Renewable Subscription Terms:
Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
The price corresponds to the same price segment, which are set in the "Apple's App Store Matrix" for other currencies.
* Your free trial subscription will automatically renew to a paid subscription unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period. 
* Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
* You can cancel a free trial or subscription anytime by turning off auto-renewal through your iTunes account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service.
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Terms of Service: 
https://www.itranslate.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: 
https://www.itranslate.com/privacy-policy
California Privacy Rights: 
https://www.itranslate.com/privacy-policy#InformationCaliforniaPrivacyRights
• An internet connection is required to use the app.

bluejetty:00095005:android.summary: Telega Messenger is created for those who appreciate freedom of communication, data safety, and productivity. Tailoring it to the needs of Russian-speaking users, we offer a familiar interface to focus on what is truly important - connectio
bluejetty:00095005:android.description:
Telega Messenger is created for those who appreciate freedom of communication, data safety, and productivity. Tailoring it to the needs of Russian-speaking users, we offer a familiar interface to focus on what is truly important - connection with family, friends and workmates.
Why should you choose Telega? 
⚙️ Extended features
Parental Control: manage your child's communication safety by setting up permissions for trusted contacts, group chats, and channels.
App redesign: we bring you a new interface with a minimalistic design, refreshed color palette and icons, and unique wallpapers with Russian national flair. 
Hide your phone number: secure your privacy by disabling your number visibility.
Switch off Stories: deactivate the Stories function for a less distracting experience.
Mishap prevention: to avoid slip-ups, turn on a verification before sending a voice message or starting a call. 
Camera settings for video calls: choose a camera that will be used by default while recording video calls or change it just before them. 
Customizable Menu: add, remove or reorganize menu bar items at your discretion.
🌍 Limitless communication 
Thanks to cloud technologies, your messages, media files and documents are always at your fingertips. The data synchronization is magically instant, which lets you start a chat on one device and seamlessly switch to another. 
💬 Simplicity and Convenience 
Intuitively understandable interface. We cut out the distractions for you to concentrate on what really matters - conversations and ideas. 
🔒Complete Privacy 
Telega doesn’t share your personal data with third parties or use it for advertising. What’s yours remains intact. 
 🚀 Fast even with a slow connection
 Wherever you are - in the city or the wilds - Telega enables fast messaging and media exchange in any internet speed conditions. 
🤝 Collaboration Empowerment 
Telega is a perfect tool to create group chats, launch projects and share something special. Simplicity and instancy are the keys to efficient interaction. 
✨ Endless opportunities for creativity
Express yourself freely using emojis, stickers and GIFs. 
Read on Telega. Write on Telega. Look into Telega. 
Telega - when faraway is at your fingertips.

bluejetty:00171524:ios.name: Pixen - pixel art editor
bluejetty:00171524:ios.summary: Pixen is a native pixel art editor for iOS and macOS, designed for working with low-resolution raster art such as those 8-bit sprites found in old-school video games. Pixen packs all the tools pixel artists need in an intuitive, native inte
bluejetty:00171524:ios.description:
Pixen is a native pixel art editor for iOS and macOS, designed for working with low-resolution raster art such as those 8-bit sprites found in old-school video games. Pixen packs all the tools pixel artists need in an intuitive, native interface including support for high zoom levels, animation editing, color palettes, and a lot more.
PROJECTS GALLERY
The Pixen experience starts in the projects gallery, which allows you to manage all of your creations in one place. You can import and export files in various file formats including PNG, JPEG, GIF, ICO, BMP, TIFF, SVG, and PSD. Files can be imported from your Photos library, the Files app, or the clipboard. Pixen for macOS users can take advantage of seamless iCloud sync. When you're ready, you can share your creations with friends.
TOOLS AND APPLE PENCIL
Leverage Pixen's wide array of tools when composing pixel art: Pencil, Eraser, Brightness, Text, Eyedropper, Zoom, Rectangular Selection, Magic Wand, Lasso, Move, Fill, Line, Rectangle, and Ellipse.
All of Pixen's tools are fully compatible with Apple Pencil on iPad. You can take advantage of the double-tap gesture on Apple Pencil 2 to quickly switch to your last tool, switch to the eraser, or bring up the color picker. Pixen even has hover support when using Apple Pencil Pro, so you can see a preview of what you're about to draw before your Apple Pencil touches the screen.
COLOR PALETTES
With Pixen, you can add and organize commonly-used colors into palettes. Pixen can also import and export color palettes in the Adobe Color Table, Microsoft Palette, JASC Palette, and GIMP Palette formats. You can even perform palette operations such as sorting colors and removing duplicate colors directly in the app.
ANIMATIONS
Create and arrange image frames in the filmstrip view to piece together animations. Pixen can import animated PNGs, animated GIFs, and sprite sheets. It can export animations as animated GIFs, animated PNGs, movies, image sequences, and sprite sheets!
GRID
Take advantage of Pixen's grid and alignment tools and create pixel-perfect artwork.
PATTERNS
Define custom patterns to use while drawing with the Pencil, Line, or Eraser tool (instead of a single pixel). You can even import patterns from 1-bit images.
PREVIEW
While editing at high zoom levels, use the Preview feature to view the canvas scaled out. You can play back animations and tile small images, useful when working on repeated patterns.
AND A LOT MORE...
- Sync your creations with Pixen for Mac over iCloud and resume your work right where you left off, regardless of device.
- Take advantage of the flexibility of layers and change opacities, blend modes, and more to compose creative effects.
- Invert colors, convert to grayscale, apply sepia tone, remove alpha components, palettize, pixellate, adjust hue, exposure, brightness, contrast, and more.
- Pixel Perfect mode removes extra pixels while drawing such that any drawn paths are at most 1 pixel in width. In other words, it removes the middle pixel of an L shape.
- Pick a flat, striped, or checkered background to be drawn beneath the canvas, or set a reference image.
- If you use your iPad with a keyboard, increase productivity with Pixen's wide array of keyboard shortcuts.
- Export your artwork in PNG, JPEG, GIF, ICO, BMP, TIFF, SVG, and PSD file formats.
- Share your creations quickly and easily via AirDrop, Messages, email, and more!
- Adjust the size and position of Pixen's sidebars, customize the Apple Pencil 2 double-tap gesture, and more.
Pixen is also available for macOS and is the only pixel art maker of its class that syncs projects with iCloud!

bluejetty:00145618:ios.name: Qibla Finder - Prayer Times
bluejetty:00145618:ios.summary: Qibla finder and Prayer times is the application to find the direction of the Kaaba in Mecca on maps compass, 99 names of allah, islamic prayer times and convert from gregorian calendar to hijri calendar(islamic calendar) . The application
bluejetty:00145618:ios.description:
Qibla finder and Prayer times is the application to find the direction of the Kaaba in Mecca on maps compass, 99 names of allah, islamic prayer times and convert from gregorian calendar to hijri calendar(islamic calendar) . The application will find qibla location in real-time and you can use it anywhere in the world.
GPS technology will help you find direction qibla quickly and exactly. To show your current location on maps you need to enable gps and connect to the internet. Maps will rotate when you move direction and connect to Kaaba in Mecca.
We provide two modes for qibla locator, you can use compass maps(online) or offline with qibla direction finder. I suggest you should use find qibla maps with online mode. Because the application will be active with accurate location on maps compass in the realtime.
* Direction for compass:
+ N is the north
+ S is the south
+ E is east
+ W is the west
+ SE is the Southeast
+ SW is Southwest
+ NE is North-East
Features:
- Kaaba direction: We use a smart compass combined with maps compass to find qibla location.
- Mosque near me: The application will help you to find a nearby Mosque at your current location. You can find the nearest mosque or Masjid easily. At any place in the world , you can use the qibla direction finder application for prayer.
- Arrow Qibla Direction: simple to find the qibla on screen with only an arrow and angle.
- Muslim prayer times with islamic calendar : Fair, Asr. Sunrise, Maghrib, Dhuhr, Isha
- Listen 99 names of allah by audio player
- Show True North
- Show Altitude Speed Calculate degrees of Qibla from existing place
- Magnetic strength
- Show Sensor State
- Show latitude longitude
- Show level
- Calculate degrees of Qibla from an existing place. The Qibla direction locator app uses the sensor of your iphone device for accurate Qibla direction.
We hope Qibla finder - Prayer times will be helpful for you. If this application isn't good. Please contact us via email:onedevzteam@gmail.com.
Thanks.

bluejetty:00183855:ios.description:
Track your savings goals and save up for what you want: a new car, a vacation, a house, a wedding or an emergency fund. Money Goals is a simple savings tracker and piggy bank for your phone. No bank login, no sign-up, no subscription.
Over 1 million goals created.
SAVE FOR WHAT YOU WANT
- Create a goal with a target amount and a date
- Add a photo of what you're saving for, or pick an icon and colour
- See every goal and your total progress on one screen
- See your goals as a compact list, photo tiles or large cards
SEE HOW MUCH TO SAVE
- Money Goals works out how much to put aside daily, weekly or monthly to reach each goal by your date
- Know exactly how much is left and how close you are
YOUR GOAL ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
- Add the Money Goals widget and see your goal without opening the app
- Your goal's photo, how much you've saved and how much to save this week
- Small and medium sizes, light and dark
FILL YOUR PIGGY BANK
- Add money in a couple of taps and watch the progress bar grow
- Keep a history of every deposit
- Made a mistake? Edit or delete any contribution
KEEP IT PRIVATE
- No bank account connection, no login, no sign-up
- Your goals stay on your device
- Lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode
NEVER MISS A DEPOSIT
- Daily, weekly or monthly reminders for each goal
- A gentle nudge with the amount to add to stay on track
SAVE IN ANY CURRENCY
- Dollars, euros, pounds, yen and many more
- Give each goal its own currency
REACH IT. CELEBRATE.
- Every reached goal gets its own celebration
- Completed goals stay in your history, so you can see how far you've come
FREE AND PRO
Money Goals is free to download and use with up to 2 goals.
Money Goals Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. Pay once and it's yours forever:

- Dark and system themes
- App lock with Face ID, Touch ID or passcode
Questions or ideas? Write to us from Settings → Support. We read every message.

bluejetty:00027463:ios.description:
Drift into Peaceful Sleep with Sleep Sounds Relax & Chillax!
Say goodbye to sleepless nights and restless moments with Sleep Sounds Relax & Chillax, your go-to app for relaxation and stress relief. Whether you're looking to calm your mind after a long day, meditate, or create the perfect atmosphere for sleep, we've got you covered.
Choose from a wide variety of soothing sounds like rain, ocean waves, forest ambiance, and more! Customize your soundscape by mixing sounds to create the ideal blend that helps you relax, unwind, and fall asleep faster.
With its easy-to-use interface and sleep timer feature, you can set the perfect sound to guide you to dreamland and wake up refreshed. Perfect for sleep, focus, meditation, or simply enjoying a moment of calm in your busy day.
Download Sleep Sounds Relax & Chillax today and enjoy a more peaceful, stress-free life!
How it works:
• Select sounds and melodies you like or Record your own
• Combine them to create a mix
• Adjust the volume of each sound individually
• Set the timer
• Lay back and relax
Features:
• More than 160 High Quality Relaxing Sound, Music Loops, Ambient Sounds and Isochronic Brainwaves to Choose and Mix
• Presets for your Mood
• Record your own Sounds
• Thousands of combinations for sound mixes
• Individual volume adjustment & Unlimited Mixing Option
• Save Your Mixes for later use
• Timer feature to set a duration when you go to sleep
• App runs in the background and while screen is locked
• AirPlay Supported
• Works without internet connection and also in Lock Screen..
According to the National Sleep Foundation, getting enough sleep is directly connected to better health. So we know it's important to get a good night's rest.
White noise has been shown to not only help people fall asleep more quickly, but also it can disguise other noises that may wake you during the night.
Repetitive or ambient music is very good for falling asleep. What's especially important is that there be no dramatic shifts in the dynamics of the music. 
Want new sounds ? Write a review and let us know.

bluejetty:00153979:ios.description:
Chaos in the parking lot! Can you untangle the traffic?
Welcome to Color Park Challenge, the addictive new puzzle game that tests your logic and precision. The parking lot is a mess, and it’s up to you to guide every car to its rightful spot.
The rule is simple: Red cars go in red spots, blue cars in blue spots! Sounds easy? Wait until the lot gets crowded!
How to Play:
- Tap the car you want to move.
- Tap the empty parking spot matching the car's color.
- Watch the car zoom into place!
- Clear the level by parking everyone correctly.
Why you’ll love Color Park Challenge:
- Simple Controls: Just tap-to-select and tap-to-move. Easy for anyone to pick up!
- Brain Teasing Puzzles: Plan your moves carefully to avoid getting blocked in.
- Satisfying Gameplay: Nothing beats the feeling of a perfectly organized parking lot.
- Vibrant Graphics: Colorful cars and environments to keep you engaged.
Ready to become the ultimate parking master? Download Color Park Challenge today and start parking!

bluejetty:00023515:ios.description:
Learn and train Muay Thai anywhere – no gym, no partner, no equipment needed.
Muay Thai Workout takes you from your first stance to elite-level combos with clear HD video demonstrations, a coach voice that guides every rep and structured programs built around your goal.
THE ART OF EIGHT LIMBS, STEP BY STEP
• 143 moves with HD video: punches, kicks, elbows, knees, blocks, evasion, footwork and stance
• Clear instructions and pro tips for every move
• 56-day challenges for Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced and Elite
• Focused workouts for kicks, defense, footwork, warm-up and stretching

A COACH IN YOUR POCKET
• Choose from 4 coach voices that count you through every move
• Resume an unfinished workout anytime
• Smart reminders to keep your streak alive
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Workout history, calories and training time in Report
• 48 achievements with brand-new Muay Thai medals
• Weight tracking and a simple meal plan
• Apple Health integration
MADE FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
• Native design with full dark mode
• Available in 18 languages

bluejetty:00161609:ios.summary:
