bluejetty:00161609:ios.description:
TRANSFORM SCREEN TIME INTO LEARNING
Looking for the perfect educational app for toddlers, preschoolers, and kindergartners?
Binky ABC is an all-in-one learning solution designed for children ages 2–7. With over 300 engaging activities, it turns early education into joyful play.
From ABC tracing and phonics games to spelling, songs, and early reading practice — every activity builds confidence and real skills through fun interaction.
DEVELOPED BY EARLY EDUCATION EXPERTS
All content in Binky ABC is created in collaboration with educators and child psychologists.
The curriculum follows preschool and kindergarten standards to support literacy, language development, and phonics mastery.
Children build essential skills for school success — step by step, at their own pace.
PERSONALIZED LEARNING PATH
Every child is different — and so is their learning path.
Binky ABC automatically adapts activities based on your child’s age, interests, and progress, helping them grow cognitively, emotionally, and socially.
Kids gain focus, memory, creativity, communication skills, and a love for learning.
WHAT’S INSIDE
• ABC Letter Tracing 
• Spelling & Sight Words
• Alphabet Games & Flashcards
• Phonics & Sound Matching
• Songs, Learning Videos & Interactive Books
• Writing Practice & Read-Along Stories
WHY FAMILIES LOVE THIS APP
• Easy progress tracking for parents
• Intuitive, child-friendly design
• 100% ad-free — no interruptions
• No in-app distractions — all content is kid-safe
• Works offline — great for home and travel
• Covers all key early learning areas: reading, writing, phonics, vocabulary
• Perfect for preschool prep or homeschooling
LEARNING THROUGH PLAY
Children learn best when they’re having fun.
Whether you want to boost literacy, support preschool learning, or make screen time more meaningful — Binky ABC turns every moment into a valuable learning opportunity.
GET STARTED
Download the app and start exploring a wide range of educational content.
You can unlock learning sets such as:
• Alphabet Game Full Version
• Alphabet Writing Games
• Phonics
• Puzzle ABC Games
• Songs and Videos
• Spell the Word ABC Games — all available individually or as a complete learning bundle.
PRIVACY POLICY
Your child’s safety and privacy are our top priorities.
Binky ABC never shows third-party ads or collects personal data.
We fully comply with the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) to ensure a safe and secure experience.
Start your child’s learning adventure today with Binky ABC — the all-in-one educational app for toddlers, preschoolers, and kindergarten kids!

Avenues, skyscrapers and squares in Paris, London, New York, Rome, Madrid and many more, at dawn and at night, in slow motion. Travel the world without leaving home: in the background while you work, at a dinner party or to relax.
YOUR SCENES
• Every time you open the app, a different scene fills the screen
• Pick another in the panel at the bottom, or swipe up to see them all
• “Shuffle” plays all the scenes one after another in random order
• Scenes in 4K and HD, in portrait and landscape, on iPhone and iPad
EFFECTS AND MODES
• Snow, rain, light rays, sparkles, confetti and bubbles over the scene
• Ready-made modes in one tap: winter, sunset, rainy night, party and calm
• Color tones: warm, cool, sunset, night and vignette
CLOCK, WEATHER AND SLEEP TIMER
• Swipe up on the scene to add a clock with the time and date
• Your city’s weather in a corner of the screen
• A sleep timer so the scene stops on its own when you fall asleep
• Change the speed of the scene or dim the screen
YOUR MUSIC
• Mute the scene and listen to your own music while you watch
ON YOUR TV
• Mirror your screen with AirPlay to watch the scene on your Apple TV or a compatible TV: the app shows you how, step by step
• Works with Chromecast
• Your photos on TV: your albums or our gallery, as a full-screen slideshow
PREMIUM
Premium gives you all the effects and modes, the clock wherever you like, the weather on screen, the sleep timer, all qualities and no ads. The subscription renews automatically; you can cancel it at any time in your Apple Account settings.
Privacy Policy: http://jewelsapps.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use (EULA): http://jewelsapps.com/terms-of-use/
